reviews.content: 一门小众宝藏课，professors和tutor都太nice了吧！！（选的tutor是Yuanfang老师）。课程设置和wl都跟中国园林那节课很像，毕竟是同样的教授。field trips超多，去了四次慈山寺、一次志莲净苑。是在香港快节奏的日子里，让身心慢下来的难得体验。 （field trip report却只需要写一篇哈哈，所以超良心！爱了！） final paper提前写好还能拿去给Dr.Xu或tutor看，会收到很细致很有帮助的feedback。适合想了解更多佛学文化/建筑/艺术的朋友。龟fair，最后A range
reviews.translated_content: A niche hidden gem of a course. The professors and tutor are all so nice!! (I chose Tutor Yuanfang). The course structure and workload are very similar to the Chinese Gardens course, as they have the same professor. There are many field trips: four visits to Tsz Shan Monastery and one to Chi Lin Nunnery. It is a rare experience that allows your body and mind to slow down in Hong Kong’s fast-paced days. (You only need to write one field trip report, haha, so it’s very conscientious! Loved it!) You can write the final paper in advance and show it to Dr. Xu or the tutor to receive very detailed and helpful feedback. Suitable for friends who want to learn more about Buddhist culture/architecture/art. The grading is fair. I got an A-range grade in the end.

reviews.content: 好grade课！lecture完全不用听，tut好好听，轻松a-（问过了 这门课不给a+，最高是a）2次quiz，tutor会提示你考啥 2次trip回来写个report gp3人组队，一个人3分钟，基本也很简单 最后有个long essay。平时和prof和tutor都可普通话交流，真的teaching team很nice，建议多和tutor交流，沟通思路，TA Mechelle会给很详细的建议。这门课我真的好爱！大家都来上。 仔细回想一下prof课上其实也很有意思哈哈哈哈哈
reviews.translated_content: A course where good grades are attainable! You don’t need to listen to the lectures at all. Listen well in tutorials, and you can easily get an A- (I asked; this course does not give A+, the highest is A). Two quizzes; the tutor will hint at what will be tested. After two trips, you write a report. The group project involves teams of three, with each person speaking for 3 minutes, which is basically very simple. Finally, there is a long essay. You can communicate with the prof and tutor in Mandarin. The teaching team is really nice. I suggest communicating more with the tutor to discuss ideas; TA Mechelle gives very detailed advice. I really love this course! Everyone should take it. Thinking back carefully, the prof’s classes are actually quite interesting too, hahaha.

reviews.content: yr1 歪打正着捡了漏！ 我的tutor是sun yuerong小姐姐！很温柔很可爱。她也是在学习这门课的内容（所以也会有解答不上来的问题但很少），major好像就是建筑啥的。 真的是一门挺好龟的课！！ 虽然听说不会给A+ yr1 sem1 感觉整个人还迷迷糊糊所以gp就搞得比较的烂。其实gp内容不必求新但一定要有自己的思考什么的，要有趣！！ 最后essay也是赶出来的55其实不应该这样因为tutor会很认真的帮你。 但最后拿了A-还是很满足的！！ 内容可能并不是特别的有趣，但教授是很有意思的！ 还是强推给大家！
reviews.translated_content: Year 1, stumbled upon a gem by luck! My tutor was Sun Yuerong, a very gentle and cute senior student. She was also learning the course content (so there were rare questions she couldn’t answer), and her major seemed to be architecture or something similar. It’s truly a course where good grades are attainable!! Although I heard they don’t give A+s. In Year 1 Sem 1, I was still confused, so my group project performance was quite poor. Actually, the group project content doesn’t need to be novel, but it must show your own thinking and be interesting!! I rushed my final essay too, which I shouldn’t have done because the tutor helps very seriously. But I was still very satisfied with the final A-!! The content might not be particularly interesting, but the professor is very engaging! Highly recommended to everyone!

reviews.content: 好龟好龟课！确实付出了很多，也确实得到了预想的回报。pre我们组选择了一个比较大的话题，可以拆分成三个部分，所以essay直接一人一个部分了，节省了一些力气。全程我们都在和tutor沟通选题和内容的调整，她也很耐心很细致，真的好好人呜呜呜。quiz的话是课上讲过的部分，总体难度不难，但也要做做准备。essay的话，我看了之前的好龟essay，分析他们好的原因和思路，然后对自己的做修改，也根据tutor在pre的时候给的建议做了修改，总体而言要言之有物思路清晰地研究一个论题。多找找相关的资料和书籍，会让自己的思路清晰很多，毕竟人家研究了一辈子的东西我们选取一个小角度都有很多东西可写。总结为需要找准努力方向，及时找反馈，以及要找优秀作业做参考。
reviews.translated_content: A course where good grades are attainable! I did put in a lot of effort, and I definitely got the return I expected. For the presentation, our group chose a broad topic that could be split into three parts, so each of us handled one part for the essay, which saved some effort. Throughout the process, we communicated with the tutor about topic selection and content adjustments; she was very patient and detailed—truly a wonderful person. The quiz covered material taught in class; overall it wasn’t difficult, but you still need to prepare. For the essay, I looked at previous high-scoring essays, analysed why they were good and their line of reasoning, then revised my own work. I also made changes based on the tutor’s feedback during the presentation. Overall, you need to research a topic with substance and clear logic. Looking for more relevant materials and books will clarify your thinking a lot; after all, scholars have spent their lives studying these topics, so even if we pick a small angle, there is plenty to write about. To summarise: find the right direction for your effort, seek feedback promptly, and use excellent past assignments as references.

reviews.content: 到底是谁在说wl小？ 我反手就是一巴掌
reviews.translated_content: Who on earth is saying the workload is light? I’d slap them right back.

reviews.content: 讲佛学建筑的课！给龟很好，整体wl不大，一个field trip report一个group project一个final essay，上学期专业课很多，上这个cc课觉得很合适～tutorial多发言tutor基本就会认识你。最好的就是有很多field trip！！大概去了三次慈山寺和一次志莲净苑，一下午都和朋友在外面玩感觉很有意思:D 但是这门课的field trip可能五点多才能回来，所以最好不要安排别的cc课在4:30-6:30。还有就是这门课真的挺archi的，而且主要讲的是中国和日本的佛寺，其实我个人对东南亚和西藏的佛教更感兴趣一些，但是这两个topic我记得每个只有一个lecture就带过去了～有一点点失望。但是总体这门课还是很值得上的，尤其对古代中国感兴趣的同学们会觉得很有意思的！
reviews.translated_content: A course on Buddhist architecture! Grading is generous, and the overall workload is light: one field trip report, one group project, and one final essay. I had many major courses last semester, so taking this Common Core course felt very suitable. If you speak up more in tutorials, the tutor will basically get to know you. The best part is the many field trips!! We went to Tsz Shan Monastery about three times and Chi Lin Nunnery once. Spending the afternoon hanging out with friends outside was very interesting :D However, the field trips for this course might not return until after 5 pm, so it’s best not to schedule another Common Core class between 4:30–6:30. Also, this course is quite architecture-focused, mainly discussing Chinese and Japanese Buddhist temples. Personally, I’m more interested in Southeast Asian and Tibetan Buddhism, but I recall those topics were only covered in one lecture each, which was a bit disappointing. But overall, this course is still worth taking, especially for students interested in ancient China, who will find it very interesting!

reviews.content: 两位老师很博学，上课选的佛教建筑都非常有意思，包含世界各地的佛寺，个人很喜欢中国和日本的佛寺部分，非建院生听着有些吃力，但是全当科普，学到了很多知识。tutor tian meng xiao人也非常好，prez会给很友善的建议。wl不大，prez+quizes+field trip report+essay。两次trip去的地方都很漂亮，真的可以好好感受佛寺。最后分数A range，目前上过最好龟的cc课。
reviews.translated_content: Both instructors are very knowledgeable. The Buddhist architecture selected for class is very interesting, covering temples from around the world. I personally enjoyed the sections on Chinese and Japanese temples. As a non-Architecture student, I found it somewhat challenging to follow, but I treated it as general knowledge and learned a lot. Tutor Tian Meng Xiao is also very nice and gives friendly advice for presentations. The workload is not heavy: presentation + quizzes + field trip report + essay. The two trips went to beautiful places where you can truly appreciate Buddhist temples. I received an A-range grade. This is currently the Common Core course with the most generous grading I have taken.

reviews.content: workload goes into reading and live discussion in tutorials, no field trip bcs of covid, and 2 small quizzes which is essay based, but very simple and sometimes doesn't relate to lectures at all.
reviews.translated_content: workload goes into reading and live discussion in tutorials, no field trip bcs of covid, and 2 small quizzes which is essay based, but very simple and sometimes doesn't relate to lectures at all.

reviews.content: harsh and changeable score standard. not a good choice
reviews.translated_content: harsh and changeable score standard. not a good choice

reviews.content: 烂龟警告！！！ workload不大，一个月的drug diary，一篇300字short paper, 一个quiz, final project是录一个角色扮演小视频（也可能是group project演一个小短剧）。 课程很注重science和art的结合，要求掌握一些关于毒品的术语和知识，也要求在short paper和final project里体现creativity和哲学思考。 总体评价：交叉性很强的一门cc，有趣，但对英文水平要求较高（你要记专业术语，也要会文学性表达）。native English speaker很多。
reviews.translated_content: Warning: harsh grading!!! The workload isn’t heavy: a one-month drug diary, a 300-word short paper, one quiz, and a final project that involves recording a short role-play video (or possibly a group project acting out a short skit). The course places strong emphasis on combining science and art. You need to master some terminology and knowledge about drugs, and you are also required to demonstrate creativity and philosophical thinking in the short paper and final project. Overall verdict: a Common Core course with strong interdisciplinary content. It’s interesting, but demands a high level of English proficiency (you need to memorize technical terms and also express yourself in a literary way). There are many native English speakers.

reviews.content:
cchu9078
内容：Lecture1介绍冥想。Lecture2介绍其历史。Lecture3介绍 contemplative。Lecture4讲如何善待自我。Lecture5数字时代中如何面对社交媒体。Lecture6自己观看影片。Lecture7社会善行。 Lecture8艺术作为冥想实践。Lecture9Be authentic，对自己，对他人。感觉除了七和八，其他的内容都非常扎实能够启发人思考。Professor发音非常标准，而且声音就是标准的冥想助眠音频那类的声音，听着让人非常舒服。整体感觉还是非常不错的。tutorial每两周有一个，tutorial1 selfawareness。tutorial2阅读relaxation revolution然后进行mindful being set的理解；介绍正念饮食。tutorial3阅读材料后讨论self compassiion；介绍想象是冥想。tutorial4探讨当代社交媒体的使用；介绍正念使用社交媒体。tutorial5讨论keyvalue，为自己寄一个时间胶囊。tutorial注重讨论感受与表达，tutor人非常好。
形式：lecture不计attendance，每周有一个，非常放松。tutorial记attendance，但每两周一个也比较轻松。没有作业没有考试，只要写一个1200词的观影评价和四篇300词的对不同主题的反思，我本身就是一个喜欢思考和总结的人，做这些作业总超出许多词数，这些作业真的能够让我们不断去思考。还有group project，选择一种有创意的方式来输出有关contemplative的内容，我们小组选择拍一部短片，也是用了一两天就处理了，最后还要进行一个presentation，对此进行介绍，不用花费多大功夫。总体来说workload非常小，但如果只把它当成刷龟的一门课，就大大低估了它的作用，他真的让我在刚步入大学的时候，面对不断加速的时代，有一颗静下来的心，去慢下来，调整自己。
作用：Lecture能够系统的介绍冥想的知识，能够激发我的思考。Tutorial对此进行一些实践，讨论，感受并介绍一些冥想方法。这门课真的能够让大家在不断变快，不断变焦虑，不断变急躁的大学生活中慢下来，找到属于自己的节奏。
其他：建议可以同时去学习b站上“李冉在冥想”的相关视频，他又系统地介绍了冥想。
reviews.translated_content: CCHU9078  Content: Lecture 1 introduces meditation. Lecture 2 covers its history. Lecture 3 introduces the contemplative. Lecture 4 discusses how to be kind to oneself. Lecture 5 addresses dealing with social media in the digital age. Lecture 6 involves watching videos on your own. Lecture 7 covers social benevolence. Lecture 8 explores art as a meditative practice. Lecture 9 is about being authentic—to yourself and others. I feel that apart from Lectures 7 and 8, the other content is very substantial and thought-provoking. The professor’s pronunciation is very standard, and his voice is like those standard meditation sleep-aid recordings, which is very soothing. Overall, it feels quite good.  Tutorials are held every two weeks. Tutorial 1 covers self-awareness [REDACTED_HANDLE]. Tutorial 2 involves reading The Relaxation Revolution and understanding mindful being sets; it introduces mindful eating. Tutorial 3 discusses self-compassion after reading materials; it introduces imagination as meditation. Tutorial 4 explores contemporary social media use; it introduces mindful social media use. Tutorial 5 discusses key values and having you send a time capsule to yourself. Tutorials focus on discussing feelings and expression, and the tutor is very nice.  Format: Lecture attendance is not counted. There is one lecture per week, very relaxed. Tutorial attendance is counted, but since they’re only every two weeks, it’s also quite light. There are no assignments or exams. You just need to write one 1,200-word film review and four 300-word reflections on different themes. As someone who enjoys thinking and summarising, I always exceeded the word count for these assignments. These tasks really encourage continuous reflection. There’s also a group project where you choose a creative way to output content related to the contemplative. Our group chose to shoot a short film, which we processed in just a day or two. Finally, there’s a presentation to introduce it, which doesn’t require much effort. Overall, the workload is very small. But if you treat it merely as a GPA booster, you greatly underestimate its value. It truly helped me, as I entered university, to calm my mind in an accelerating era, slow down, and adjust myself.  Impact: Lectures systematically introduce knowledge about meditation and stimulate my thinking. Tutorials provide some practice, discussion, feeling, and introduction to meditation methods. This course really allows students to slow down amidst the increasingly fast, anxious, and impatient university life, and find their own rhythm.  Other: I suggest simultaneously watching the relevant videos by “Li Ran Meditates” on Bilibili, as he also systematically introduces meditation.

reviews.content: 老师语速比较快，英语水平很不错。上课的内容不太有趣，涉及contemplative的历史，科学原理，应用等方面。但是即使不听课不看reading只看lecture notes也可以完成group project和essay。平时不需要花太多时间，但11月写essay和做group project有点花时间，建议统筹好各门课的时间再考虑是否选这门课。group project和essay的给分都没有告诉我们，不知道是如何打分的，最后B。
reviews.translated_content: The teacher speaks relatively fast and has good English proficiency. The class content isn’t very interesting; it covers the history, scientific principles, and applications of contemplative practices. However, even if you don’t attend class or do the readings, you can still complete the group project and essay by just looking at the lecture notes. You don’t need to spend much time usually, but writing the essay and doing the group project in November takes some time. I suggest managing your time across all courses before deciding whether to take this one. We weren’t told how the group project and essay were graded, so I don’t know the marking criteria. I ended up with a B.

reviews.content: 其實就是教冥想的課堂 每堂一開始都會做5分鐘冥想 做完之後大家都各做各的事了 因為課堂極其無聊比佛學更無聊 以為是水課結果踩雷 後期2500字的反思文極其難寫 可以寫冥想的改變 但是我真的沒有任何改變 吹水都寫不出 每堂tutorial之後都要寫400字文 很容易忘記交 但是寫完之後老師沒有給任何評語甚至分數都沒有 （寫了一大堆東西結果都不知道老師有沒有看） 在tutorial發表了很多意見但是grade令人大跌眼鏡 不知道評分準則如何 反而小組交的影片只用了兩三天做 反而出了成績還行 非常令人疑惑如何評分的 想要A range的可以遠離了
reviews.translated_content: It’s essentially a meditation class. Each session starts with 5 minutes of meditation, after which everyone does their own thing. Because the class was extremely boring—more boring than Buddhist studies—I thought it would be an easy course, but it turned out to be a trap. The 2,500-word reflection paper towards the end was extremely difficult to write. You could write about changes brought by meditation, but I genuinely experienced no change; I couldn’t even pad it with fluff. After every tutorial, you had to write a 400-word piece. It’s easy to forget to submit, but the teacher gave no comments or even scores after submission (I wrote a lot but don’t even know if the teacher read it). I shared many opinions in tutorials, but the grade was disappointing. I don’t know what the grading criteria were. On the other hand, the group video project, which we only spent two or three days on, received a decent grade. It’s very confusing how grading works. If you want an A-range grade, stay away.

reviews.content: 要求寫三篇essay還有交一個multi media group project。三篇essay一篇feedback都沒有，你根本不知道自己寫的怎麼樣。grading完全不公開透明，只能拿到final grade，跟開盲盒一模一樣。workload是真的小，但想拿a range的話還是別選這個吧，太tm玄乎了
reviews.translated_content: You are required to write three essays and submit a multimedia group project. You don’t get any feedback on the three essays, so you have no idea how well you wrote. The grading is completely non-transparent; you only receive the final grade, making it exactly like opening a blind box. The workload is genuinely small, but if you want to get an A-range grade, don’t choose this course. It’s way too unpredictable.

reviews.content:
超级有意思的一门课，wl对我这个cds院的来说完全可以接受！（甚至感觉很轻松哈哈哈）
首先课程内容类似艺术+社会学的交叉，focus on一些不同文化圈中的酷儿元素，你总能遇到你感兴趣的topic
例如：日漫，BL，GL，芭蕾，韩剧，韩娱，变装，公共空间设计，本土文化与殖民历史……
每一个topic都会请该领域的专家来讲。比如变装（Drag）那一课，请来了一个Drag queen，结课后还邀请我们免费去兰桂坊酒吧，报上cchu9079就可以免费看他表演

GPA的两个重头就是project和essay了，也都非常有意思！（剩下的基本上就是答到，看视频刷课时这种送分的东西）
先说project，就是小组拍一个视频，展示对某个酷儿文化的理解。体裁不限，拍短剧，采访，分析都可以。当时课上放的别人的成果都好有意思😭好多文艺同性爱情小短片，大家看得都好嗨。我们组因为懒得折腾弄了一个关于媒体中的刻板性别角色之类的，分析评述性的视频，直接写好稿子读然后剪成视频，没怎么费事

再说essay，选择十个题目进行回答，一个小问300字左右。可以选自己感兴趣的，我基本都在分析各种漫画相关的酷儿性和影响发展之类之类题目，所以写得也很开心，而且是一个个小sub topic拆开写的，也不觉得有什么wl

虽然看不见这两个东西的具体得分，但我们gp组员好多是A，我也是A，太高兴了，强烈推荐这个课，好龟，有意思，重要的是，还能遇见不少有意思的朋友和同好！
reviews.translated_content: A super interesting course. The workload is totally acceptable for me as a CDS student! (It even feels quite relaxed, haha.) First, the course content is like an intersection of art and sociology, focusing on queer elements in different cultural spheres. You will always encounter topics that interest you, for example: Japanese anime, BL, GL, ballet, Korean dramas, K-pop, drag, public space design, local culture and colonial history... Each topic features an expert speaker. For example, in the drag lesson, a drag queen was invited, and after the course ended, we were invited to a Lan Kwai Fong bar for free; if you mention CCHU9079, you can watch his performance for free. The two main components for GPA are the project and the essay, and both are very interesting! (The rest is basically just showing up, watching videos to clock attendance—easy marks.) Let’s talk about the project first: it involves filming a video in a group to demonstrate your understanding of a certain queer culture. The format is open; you can film a short drama, conduct interviews, or do an analysis. The other groups’ outputs shown in class were so interesting 😭 Many artistic gay romance short films; everyone was really excited. Our group was too lazy to go through the trouble, so we made an analytical commentary video about stereotypical gender roles in media. We just wrote a script, read it out, and edited it into a video; it didn’t take much effort. Now for the essay: you choose ten questions to answer, with each sub-question requiring about 300 words. You can choose topics that interest you. I basically analysed topics related to queerness and its development in various comics, so I enjoyed writing it. Also, since it is broken down into small sub-topics, it didn’t feel like much workload. Although we couldn’t see the specific marks for these two components, many members of our group project got As, and I got an A too. So happy. Highly recommend this course: generous grading, interesting, and importantly, you can meet many interesting friends and people with similar interests!

reviews.content: 快跑！！wl巨大，每天上课点名，每个礼拜都有tutorial，每次都要发言，i人地狱。最后几周才安排小组分组，根本来不及做，sem尾要写一篇4000字的essay，认真琢磨了一个礼拜，小组作业认真拍，最后拿了一个大B，只能说快跑...
reviews.translated_content: Run away!! The workload is huge. Attendance is taken every class, there is a tutorial every week, and you have to speak up each time—it’s hell for introverts. Group allocations were only arranged in the last few weeks, so there was no time to prepare properly. At the end of the semester, we had to write a 4,000-word essay. After seriously working on it for a week and putting serious effort into filming the group assignment, I only got a solid B. All I can say is: run away...

reviews.content: 课程主要是讲各种文化下对于同性恋的看法（好像也不是单纯地划分同性恋，整个课程就是在教性少数群体的历史和划分以及他们的苦难等等）。会有讲座，上课基本上都是在看电影，lecture会算attendance，不过lecture基本不用听，没啥用。有两篇短essay，五道题里面选三道题回答，大概1500~2000字左右。我自己上课是从来没有回答问题的，essay认真写，最后的gp是拍电影，我们组基本全是free-rider所以做得很差，但是最后还是有A-。整体来说我觉得wl算中间的，给分也还好。对性少数群体感兴趣的话应该能学习到不少相关知识
reviews.translated_content: The course mainly discusses views on homosexuality across different cultures (though it’s not simply categorizing homosexuality; the whole course teaches the history and classification of sexual minorities, their hardships, etc.). There are lectures, and class time is basically spent watching films. Attendance is counted for lectures, but you don’t really need to listen as they aren’t very useful. There are two short essays (choose three out of five questions to answer, around 1500–2000 words). I never answered questions in class. I wrote the essays carefully. The final group project was filming a movie; our group was full of free riders, so we performed poorly, but I still got an A-. Overall, I think the workload is moderate, and the grading is decent. If you’re interested in sexual minorities, you should be able to learn quite a bit.

reviews.content: 整學期的wl就是期末要做一個gp跟最後要交一份4000字essay，前期覺得wl不大沒什麼事做。professor和tutor人都蠻好的也很有趣，兩小時lecture+一小時tutorial，lecture內容基本上不需要聽反正也沒有考試。沒缺席過課堂跟tutorial，essay自認蠻認真寫，最後只拿B+，給分不是特別好，但內容算有趣，對性別議題感興趣的可以試試看。
reviews.translated_content: The workload for the whole semester consists of a group project at the end and a 4,000-word essay. In the beginning, I felt the workload was light and there wasn’t much to do. The professor and tutor are both quite nice and interesting. It’s a two-hour lecture plus a one-hour tutorial. You basically don’t need to listen to the lecture content since there’s no exam anyway. I didn’t miss any classes or tutorials, and I believe I wrote the essay quite seriously, but I only got a B+ in the end. The grading isn’t particularly good, but the content is interesting. If you’re interested in gender issues, you can give it a try.

reviews.content: 上课内容不算很有趣，有时会邀请嘉宾。
reviews.translated_content: The class content isn't very interesting. Guest speakers are sometimes invited.

reviews.content: 课程每节课任务不多但是每节课都得去，学的考古内容很有启发性，老师讲课很用心，其实3D模型一个非理工科学生也可以做得很好，Shuya是非常好的Tutor，最后A
reviews.translated_content: There isn’t much work for each class, but you have to attend every session. The archaeology content is very inspiring, and the lecturer teaches with great care. Even non-STEM students can do well on the 3D modelling task. Shuya is an excellent tutor. I ended up with an A.

reviews.content: 本來想說wl大快跑的，奈何給🐢還可以，期末最後一個pre的時候太緊張了發揮災難，結果最後還是A-了不可思議😭感謝短髮tutor（忘記名字了）wl是每節課必須去完成4-5個課堂小任務，兩個gp+pre，一個essay，一個個人3D project+pre，零基礎做得丑也沒關係，感覺還是更看內容深度。
reviews.translated_content: I originally thought the workload was heavy and wanted to run, but the grading was acceptable. I was too nervous during the final presentation and performed disastrously, yet somehow still got an A−. Unbelievable 😭 Thanks to the short-haired tutor (I forgot the name). The workload involves completing 4–5 small in-class tasks every session, two group projects with presentations, one essay, and one individual 3D project with a presentation. It’s okay if you’re a beginner and your work looks ugly; it seems they focus more on the depth of content.

reviews.content: 绝世好龟课，不摆烂基本都能有A range
reviews.translated_content: An absolutely excellent GPA-friendly course. As long as you don’t slack off, you can basically get an A-range grade.

reviews.content: 教授人很好很风趣，虽然workload非常非常大，几乎相当于两倍平均workload，但是给分很好，只要努努力基本都可以拿A，不过Peter说他从来没给过A+而且A+要总评大于等于97%，介意的同学可以考虑考虑是否选择。
reviews.translated_content: The professor is very nice and witty. Although the workload is extremely heavy—almost double the average—the grading is generous. If you put in the effort, you can basically get an A. However, Peter says he has never given an A+, and an A+ requires a total score of at least 97%. Students who mind this should consider whether to enrol.

reviews.content: workload非常大但是龟是不错的，上课也算有趣，tutor shuya非常nice，但是每节课必去，有堂上quiz和discussion，每周有阅读作业和要写forum，两次小组pre，一个个人essay，一个建模和个人pre，是读过最大workload的cc了，认真读最后有A
reviews.translated_content: The workload is very heavy, but the grading is decent. Classes are quite interesting, and the tutor, Shuya, is very nice. However, attendance at every class is mandatory, with in-class quizzes and discussions. There are weekly reading assignments and forum posts, two group presentations, one individual essay, and one modelling task with an individual presentation. It’s the Common Core course with the heaviest workload I’ve ever taken. If you study seriously, you can get an A.

reviews.content: 垃圾课 垃圾分 垃圾讲义 一定要人在做签到 唐氏课 不如换区打o或者学别的课
reviews.translated_content: Trash course, trash grades, trash lecture notes. Attendance is mandatory for sign-in. It’s a ridiculous course; you’d be better off going to another district to play Overwatch or studying something else.

reviews.content: 这是一门新课，对考古很有兴趣就抱着试试的心态选了。教授和几位Tutor都非常nice，上课内容量很大，但认真听是可以学到很多有用的考古学、历史知识的。教授还邀请了几位experts给我们分享考古相关知识，Tutorial也超级有趣！非常喜欢这门课的assignments，都超级有意思，可以去大学博物馆接触文物，可以学3D建模，可以研究考古报告，总之真的超级有意思！阅读和assignments都很多，也很紧凑，但是出于喜欢，倒还可以接受。喜欢历史喜欢考古的同学不要错过！最后分数是A range，谢谢教授和tutors！
reviews.translated_content: This is a new course. I was very interested in archaeology, so I enrolled with a try-it-out mindset. The professor and several tutors were all very nice. The lecture content was heavy, but if you listen carefully, you can learn a lot of useful archaeology and history knowledge. The professor also invited several experts to share archaeology-related knowledge with us, and the tutorials were super interesting! I really liked the assignments for this course; they were all super engaging. You could visit the university museum to handle artefacts, learn 3D modelling, and study archaeological reports—in short, it was really super interesting! There were many readings and assignments, and the schedule was tight, but because I liked it, I could accept it. Students who like history and archaeology should not miss this! I ended up with an A-range grade. Thanks to the professor and tutors!

reviews.content: 不知道为什么没有拿A+，不过课还是很有意思的，有很多interaction。
reviews.translated_content: I do not know why I did not get an A+, but the course is still very interesting, with lots of interaction.

reviews.content: 烂龟，慎选，给分不太友好。。。。。。
reviews.translated_content: Harsh grading. Choose with caution. The marking is not very friendly...

reviews.content: 本來是因為portal的關係選不到其他common core所以才隨便選了這個新開的cc 但是在上了課以後發現驚喜滿滿 教授在課裡主要討論香港的鬼故和都市傳說 有一課會主要說港大和中大的鬼故事，在y1上這門課強烈推薦對懸疑/都市傳神有興趣的同學（特別是y1的同學）去選這門課 課堂也邀請過本地實況主來學校講課，可惜因為疫情關係在課室的人只有10幾人 tutor eugene 很好，功課上會給你一些建議去做好 個人認為reflective journal看完lecture slides已經能夠寫好 free form essay有兩篇 可以拍片/設計海報單張完成（workload跟1000字essay一樣便可）兩次都是要去field trip的，一次去黃埔那邊，另一次就去校園內有都市傳說的大樓或地方去做實地考察 video那裡要組好隊選隊友，本人比較幸運，在分組的時候跟non local同組，花了半天寫稿，半天完成了拍攝部分，剪片用了大概一天 整體來說workload不算大 最後拿了B+，同組拍攝的組員都是拿B+或者B 但是聽我朋友在宿舍的同學說拿了C+ 所以個人作業特別是essay都很重要
reviews.translated_content: I originally picked this new Common Core course at random because I couldn’t enrol in other Common Core courses due to portal issues. But after attending the classes, I was pleasantly surprised. The professor mainly discussed Hong Kong ghost stories and urban legends. One lecture focused specifically on ghost stories at HKU and CUHK. I strongly recommend this course to Year 1 students interested in suspense or urban legends (especially Year 1s). The class even invited local live-streamers to give talks, though unfortunately, only about ten people could attend in person due to the pandemic. Tutor Eugene was very helpful and gave suggestions on how to improve our assignments. Personally, I found that I could write a good reflective journal just by reviewing the lecture slides. There were two free-form essays, which could be completed by making a video or designing a poster/flyer (the workload is similar to writing a 1,000-word essay). Both required field trips: one to the Whampoa area, and the other to buildings or places on campus with urban legends for on-site investigation. For the video assignment, it’s important to form a good team and choose reliable teammates. I was quite lucky to be grouped with non-local students; we spent half a day writing the script and half a day filming, and editing took about a day. Overall, the workload wasn’t heavy. I finally got a B+, and my group members who worked on the filming also got B+ or B. However, I heard from a friend’s roommate that they got a C+, so individual assignments, especially the essays, are very important.

reviews.content: 最後A了但過程痛苦 eugene人很好 但wl偏大 兩個field trip report+拍片 準備的時間比較少 而且take attendance 但去了也沒見得學到什麼
reviews.translated_content: I got an A in the end, but the process was painful. Eugene is a nice person, but the workload is on the heavier side. There are two field trip reports and a video project, with relatively little time to prepare. Attendance is taken, but I did not feel like I learned much even when I went.

course_info.requirement: Your enrollment must comply with the requirements of Common Core (CC) and your programme. Contact commoncore@hku.hk for enquiries."

reviews.content: 感觉给龟很玄学，和组员做得很认真并且也花了很多心血，以为有a range结果最后b+
reviews.translated_content: I feel the grading is opaque and unpredictable. My group members and I worked very seriously and put in a lot of effort. We thought we would get an A-range grade, but ended up with a B+.

reviews.content: 课程整体workload很小，前期上课日常划水没啥事，整个学期写了三篇小短文，两个影评作业，字数要求上限几百字反而有点恼火哈哈哈哈哈。期末gp有个海报＋微电影制作有点耗时间，除此还有一个个人的期末影评完成。 tutorail小组讨论点评，人很好但是社恐人恐怕遭不住 虽然感觉微电影和海报完成质量很不错，个人影评也是认真完成搜索各种资料，但最后也只有B，难过。
reviews.translated_content: The overall course workload is very light. In the beginning, classes were routine and I could coast through with nothing much to do. Throughout the semester, we wrote three short essays and two film review assignments. The word count limit of only a few hundred words was actually a bit annoying, hahaha. For the final group project, there was a poster and a micro-film production, which was a bit time-consuming. Besides that, there was an individual final film review to complete. Tutorials involved group discussions and critiques. The tutor is nice, but people who are very uncomfortable with social participation might not be able to handle it. Although I feel the quality of the micro-film and poster was quite good, and I completed the individual film review seriously by searching for various materials, I only got a B in the end. Sad.

reviews.content: 几乎没有workload，认真完成了但是只有B，不明白
reviews.translated_content: Almost no workload. I completed the work seriously but only got a B. I don’t understand why.

reviews.content: 性价比之选！wl还行，找到好队友的话拿a range很容易的！
reviews.translated_content: Great value! The workload is manageable, and if you find good teammates, it’s easy to get an A-range grade!

reviews.content: 没出分，但是整体体验感不错。总体来讲并不是一个专业性很强的电影课，prof上课也比较像是自己有兴趣然后随便分享分享，讲一讲的感觉。但是喜欢看电影的或者有传媒兴趣的可以选。老师很平易近人，没有tutorial。 wl是一个小quiz，一篇影评，还有比较重要的final video和poster。整体来讲平时比较轻松，不计attendance，日常的wl就是看每周布置的电影，只要看了quiz基本没问题，挺简单的。视频还有poster占大头，所以很看队友。建议提前找好团结的，能一起平摊wl的队友，不然一个人搞确实wl很大，最急的那个肯定是最费心费力的。另外就是决定好剧本后，空闲的时候尽早拍摄，这样exam week的时候就不用耗费太多心力了。
reviews.translated_content: Grades aren’t out yet, but the overall experience was quite good. Generally, this isn’t a highly professional film course; the prof teaches more like someone sharing personal interests casually. However, those who enjoy watching films or have an interest in media can take it. The teacher is very approachable, and there are no tutorials. The workload consists of a small quiz, a film review, and the more important final video and poster. Overall, the regular schedule is relaxed, attendance isn’t counted, and the daily workload is just watching the weekly assigned film; as long as you watch it, the quiz is basically no problem and quite simple. The video and poster carry the most weight, so it really depends on your teammates. I recommend finding united teammates early on who can share the workload evenly; otherwise, doing it alone creates a huge workload, and the person rushing at the deadline definitely ends up putting in the most effort. Also, once the script is decided, film during your free time as early as possible so you don’t have to expend too much energy during exam week.

reviews.content: 挺欢乐的 wl也不算高 莫名其妙拿了个A-hhhh
reviews.translated_content: Quite fun, and the workload isn’t high either. I somehow got an A– haha.

reviews.content: 整体上课氛围很不错，轻松愉快，也学到了很多关于鉴赏电影的知识，学会从不同角度去看待电影的技巧和主题。教授是外国人，口音听着蛮舒服的，发音很清楚（@谁我就不说了），人也很有趣，很和善，tutorial时候跟他讨论short film也很轻松融洽，给了很多中肯的建议。workload的确不大，而且感觉Nik已经非常会替学生考虑了，只有一个quiz，一个film➕ poster➕report	。每次坐在教室里就感觉很开心很轻松，非常享受这门课的内容，感觉Nik非常用心。上完这门课之后对电影的兴趣极大提升了🤩🤩
reviews.translated_content: The overall class atmosphere is very good, relaxed and enjoyable, and I learned a lot about film appreciation, including techniques and themes for viewing films from different perspectives. The professor is a foreigner with a pleasant accent and clear pronunciation (I won’t name names), and he is interesting and friendly. Discussing short films with him during tutorials was relaxed and harmonious, and he gave many pertinent suggestions. The workload is indeed not heavy, and Nik seems very considerate of students. There is only one quiz, and one assessment consisting of a film + poster + report. Sitting in the classroom always made me feel happy and relaxed. I really enjoyed the content of this course and felt that Nik put in a lot of effort. After taking this course, my interest in film increased greatly 🤩🤩

reviews.content: 玄学给龟，吐血爆肝最后B+。不过wl是真的不大，300字的影评，两节tutorial，期中十道选择题
reviews.translated_content: Grading is opaque and unpredictable. I poured my heart out and grinded through a huge amount of work, only to get a B+. However, the workload is indeed not heavy: a 300-word film review, two tutorials, and ten multiple-choice questions for the midterm.

reviews.content: 试水新cc。个人不太建议真正喜欢电影和学电影的人上，因为prof讲的和大多数上课的人都不是特别专业，就当玩玩比较好。workload还行，组好队很重要。最后水了一个a range
reviews.translated_content: Tried out a new Common Core course. I wouldn’t really recommend it to people who genuinely like or study film, because the professor and most of the class aren’t particularly professional; it’s better to just treat it as fun. Workload is okay, but forming a good team is important. In the end, I coasted to an A-range grade.

reviews.content: 好龟，轻松
reviews.translated_content: Easy to get a good grade, relaxed.

search_summary.requirement: 无前置要求或未提供相关数据

course_info.title: The Law in Everyday Life
course_info.requirement: 无前置要求或未提供相关数据

reviews.content: 如果你是一个不擅长写文章的人请再考虑一下（）因为学的是法律相关，所以写essay也会有点烧脑（？）不过内容确实很有趣！anya也很可爱！anya和tutor都很热心回答问题，feedback很有用。WL是每周读文章（其实是预习），一个回应文章观点的论文，一个自己想主题的论文，一个小组作业做storyboard和做视频。最后A-
reviews.translated_content: If you’re not good at writing essays, please think twice. Since the course covers law-related topics, writing essays can be quite brain-burning. However, the content is genuinely interesting! Anya is also very lovely. Both Anya and the tutor are enthusiastic about answering questions, and the feedback is very useful. The workload consists of weekly article readings (which are essentially pre-reading), one essay responding to an article’s arguments, one self-chosen topic essay, and a group assignment involving storyboarding and video production. I ended up with an A-.

reviews.content: 课程内容很有趣！WL适中，两篇essay一个storyboard一个video。Anya人超好，会帮你逐字逐句改论文，也很乐于回答问题。但是Tutor很一般，不会给有用的Feedback，期中论文给分也比较mean
reviews.translated_content: The course content is interesting! Workload is moderate: two essays, one storyboard, and one video. Anya is super nice; she’ll help you edit your essays word by word and is happy to answer questions. But the tutor is average, doesn’t give useful feedback, and the midterm grading is quite mean.

reviews.content:
老师教学生就像幼师哄小孩
幽默 温柔 耐心 认真
Tutor是Saran Cheng 认真 就是大家不配合她
reviews.translated_content: The instructor teaches students like a kindergarten teacher coaxing children: humorous, gentle, patient, and serious. The tutor is Saran Cheng, who is serious, but the class just doesn’t cooperate with her.

reviews.content: 基本没怎么去lecture 内容和作业没什么关系放心翘，，不过据我不多的印象来说的话人还挺好的 tutor选的jisu 人挺好的很有意思 wl中等 两篇essay+tut需要多发言有点累 我两次essay都是B当时有点崩溃 但最后overall给了A- 感谢gp组员感谢prof感谢tutor🙏
reviews.translated_content: I basically didn’t go to lectures much. Don’t worry about skipping, as the content isn’t really related to the assignments. However, from my limited impression, the instructor is quite nice. I chose Jisu for the tutorial; she’s nice and interesting. The workload is moderate. Two essays plus the need to speak up a lot in tutorials is a bit tiring. I got Bs for both essays and was a bit崩溃 (broken down) at the time, but finally received an A- overall. Thanks to my GP group members, thanks to the prof, and thanks to the tutor 🙏

reviews.content: 教授讲的非常好很有意思，tutorial里面jisu讲的特别好也特别nice。不是law院的也可以上，最后🐢也非常的好，比预想的还好
reviews.translated_content: The professor lectures very well and it’s interesting. Jisu, who leads the tutorials, is excellent and very nice. Students outside the Law Faculty can take this course too. The final grade was very good, even better than I expected.

reviews.content: 还可以！tutorial一般有点无聊 给分还可以吧 b+
reviews.translated_content: It’s okay! The tutorials are generally a bit boring. The grading is acceptable; I got a B+.

reviews.content: Prof讲课很有趣。任务要求和给的反馈都很详细，给分好
reviews.translated_content: The professor’s lectures are interesting. The assignment requirements and feedback provided are very detailed, and the grading is generous.

reviews.content: Professor is very nice, lectures are interesting. Workload is high but manageable if you pick good groupmates for your group project- if not, you may feel overwhelmed. Tutor was quite harsh with grades, often with little feedback. Final essay may bring your grade up
reviews.translated_content: Professor is very nice, lectures are interesting. Workload is high but manageable if you pick good groupmates for your group project- if not, you may feel overwhelmed. Tutor was quite harsh with grades, often with little feedback. Final essay may bring your grade up

reviews.content: Anya上课超级有趣而且topic大多都会贴合一些实际生活，然后wl就是一个group project的storyboard+视频和一篇final essay，其实视频并没有想象中的很难，只需要一些简单剪辑就行，重点还是内容，但是final essay可能确实要去认真弄些research
reviews.translated_content: Anya’s classes are super interesting, and most topics connect well with real life. The workload consists of a group project storyboard + video and a final essay. The video isn’t as difficult as you might imagine; basic editing is enough, and the focus is on content. However, the final essay does require serious research.

reviews.content: prof讲的特别有激情，感觉上课没什么人，toturial稍微比较水，大任务完成了课不上也没什么关系的感觉
reviews.translated_content: The professor lectured with great passion. It felt like hardly anyone attended class. The tutorials were a bit lightweight, and it felt like skipping lectures didn’t matter much once the major assignment was done.

search_summary.title: When Animals Talk Back

course_info.title: When Animals Talk Back

reviews.content: 每周一篇500词的和动物interact的diary，每周几十页的reading，上课两个小时都是提问 答不出影响成绩，期中期末各一篇800词essay，期中以后就要开始group project且需要大量时间投入，后期话题涉及屠宰及兽交 可能引起不适 没兴趣没时间没自信就别来
reviews.translated_content: A 500-word diary entry about interacting with animals every week, dozens of pages of reading each week. The two-hour lectures consist entirely of questions; failing to answer affects your grade. There is one 800-word essay for the midterm and another for the final. After the midterm, you need to start a group project that requires a significant time investment. Later topics involve slaughter and bestiality, which may cause discomfort. If you have no interest, no time, or lack confidence, don’t take this course.

reviews.content:
只上了一次课，听完介绍果断退课。润！(╯‵□′)╯︵┻━┻
（不知道龟怎么样
reviews.translated_content: I only attended one class and dropped the course immediately after the introduction. Get out while you can! (╯‵□′)╯︵┻━┻ (Not sure how the grading is.)

reviews.content: wl巨大，每周几十页reading，甚至有一周达到了一百页，且必须读完并理解，因为教授上课两小时lecture全程提问+讨论，答不出来会影响龟；essay对理科人不友好，一篇总结Derrida被tutor（Maggie人挺好 风格颇严格）说太主观不是summary给了B-，另一篇对比animal communicators 认真写了很久 只被评价了一句a very good try然后给了B+；然后groupwork也是要求了很多个小时的work 花很多时间最后是B；内容还是挺有趣的，教授也很有水平，如果感兴趣 不在乎龟且有时间应付巨量wl的话可以考虑，否则快跑
reviews.translated_content: The workload is huge: dozens of pages of reading each week, with one week hitting 100 pages. You must read and understand them all because the professor’s two-hour lecture involves questioning and discussion throughout; if you can’t answer, it will affect your grade. The essays are not friendly to science students. For one essay summarising Derrida, the tutor (Maggie is nice but quite strict in style) said it was too subjective and not a summary, giving me a B-. For another essay comparing animal communicators, I wrote carefully for a long time, only to receive the comment “a very good try” and a B+. The group work also required many hours of effort; despite spending a lot of time, I got a B. The content is quite interesting, and the professor is very capable. If you are interested, don’t care about the grade, and have time to handle the massive workload, you might consider it; otherwise, stay away.

reviews.content: 快跑！快跑！快跑！非要上的话请做好心理准备，上课内容可看其他评论
reviews.translated_content: Stay away! Stay away! Stay away! If you must take it, please be mentally prepared. For lecture content, see other reviews.

reviews.content: 快跑快跑 wl巨大 每周reading超级多
reviews.translated_content: Stay away, stay away! The workload is huge, with a massive amount of reading every week.

reviews.content: prof很有激情和动力，是真的想要让我们学到知识，是我不争气，一直用chatGPT summarise reading material ;-; 之前的评论说wl大是真的，每周都要读50-100页reading,而且难度都比较大，如果没有chatGPT我就完蛋了。不过如果你真的沉下心去读书（或者chatGPT summarise一下）,然后上课的时候不要迟到，积极发言，GP也不要乱做，我认为最后还是可以拿A的。最后说一句：这门课非常的communication intensive,如果对自己的英文口语能力不是很有自信，在选课的时候最好还是斟酌一下。
reviews.translated_content: The professor is very passionate and motivated, genuinely wanting us to learn. It was my own fault for relying on ChatGPT to summarise the reading materials ;-; The previous reviews saying the workload is heavy are true: we had to read 50–100 pages every week, and the difficulty was quite high. I would have been doomed without ChatGPT. However, if you really settle down to read (or use ChatGPT to summarise), don’t be late for class, participate actively, and don’t mess up the group project, I think you can still get an A in the end. One last note: this course is very communication-intensive. If you’re not very confident in your English speaking skills, you’d better think carefully before enrolling.

reviews.content: 巨大的wl 上课死亡问答 每周要写和animal的interaction的500字日记 我tm上哪去和animal interact啊活的动物都看不到几只我家又不是开动物园的 两份essay给分fair 最后烂龟 别上 千万别上
reviews.translated_content: Huge workload. The in-class Q&A sessions are deadly. Every week you have to write a 500-word diary about your interaction with an animal. Where the hell am I supposed to interact with animals? I can barely see any live animals; my family doesn’t run a zoo. The two essays were graded fairly, but I ended up with a poor grade. Don’t take this course. Seriously, don’t.

reviews.content: 宇宙无敌神课 好🐢 tutor很nice tutorial非常开心玩玩小游戏什么的 平时基本没有wl且只要期末交一篇essay+group project就可以
reviews.translated_content: An absolutely fantastic course. Generous grading. The tutor is very nice, and tutorials are fun with little games and such. There’s basically no workload during the semester, and you only need to submit one essay and a group project at the end.

reviews.content: 好🐢wl巨小，就一个1500字的comparative essay和一个很轻松的gp。不过lec和tutorial都记attendance，几乎没学最后也是a range。
reviews.translated_content: Good grade potential and extremely low workload: just one 1500-word comparative essay and a very relaxed group project. However, attendance is taken for both lectures and tutorials. Even though I barely studied, I still got an A-range grade.

reviews.content: 很好的宗教导论，要是完全不懂宗教值得一上。平时上课基本凭自己良心听，tutorial记attendance。期末一篇1500+gp视频，基本跟课程内容没啥关系，属于是时间花到位了会有一个体面的分数。
reviews.translated_content: It’s a good introduction to religion; worth taking if you know nothing about religion. In regular classes, you basically listen according to your own conscience; tutorials check attendance. The final consists of a 1500+ word essay and a group project video, which basically has little to do with the course content. As long as you put in the time, you’ll get a decent grade.

reviews.content: wl not that much. just gp video pre and 1500 word essay. The tutor is really nice and have a lot of activities during the tutorial , nice cc
reviews.translated_content: The workload is not that much. There is just a group video presentation and a 1,500-word essay. The tutor is really nice and includes many activities during the tutorial. A nice Common Core course.

reviews.content: Fun course, especially the tutorial by Samantha.
reviews.translated_content: Fun course, especially the tutorial by Samantha.

reviews.content: 非常非常非常好，很轻松，课没听过，最后也不错
reviews.translated_content: Excellent, excellent, excellent. Very relaxed. I didn't attend any classes, and the final result was still good.

reviews.content: 很轻松有趣的一节课 拥有绝世好tutor tutorial以游戏的形式复习 wl就是一篇1500的essay+video pre
reviews.translated_content: A very relaxed and interesting class with an absolutely wonderful tutor. Tutorials review material in the form of games. The workload is just one 1500-word essay and a video presentation.

reviews.content: 老师很好，tutor超级可爱，给分还行，wl小
reviews.translated_content: The instructor is great, the tutor is super cute, grading is decent, and the workload is light.

reviews.content: 教授和tutor都很好很可爱，两个人的上课内容都有精心准备，上课体验很好，wl也小。但我最后烂🐢了，可能是我自己的问题，不是很清楚。同组的其他朋友有好🐢的。整体还是推荐的。
reviews.translated_content: The professor and tutor are both very nice and cute. Both prepared their class content carefully, so the learning experience was good, and the workload was small. But I ended up with a poor grade, possibly due to my own issues; I’m not entirely sure. Other friends in the same group got good grades. Overall, I still recommend it.

reviews.content:
还在选CC课的童鞋看过来!!!
推荐一门超级棒的CC课：
CCHU 9088:We are Family: Myths, Realities and the Future of an Idea
 （sem 2, Wed, 12:30-14:20)
老师讲的很好，课堂内容易懂充实且有趣。
给🐢很Fair，很好🐢，且professor人超级好沟通，问问题（无论邮件还是线下）都会及时且详细地回答
professor还有其他好的CC课（motherhood…)，因为这是新课，enrollment比较少，抓住机会enroll这门新的，未来的抢手课吧
❤️❤️❤️
简介：
今天，我们被告知“家庭价值观”正受到严重威胁。结婚人数减少，离婚更容易，单亲家庭生下的孩子也增多。战争导致许多家庭流离失所，他们的家庭不断迁移。我们被告知核心家庭的理想已经过时了。多代家庭、单亲家庭、酷儿（Queer）家庭和无子女家庭在全球越来越受欢迎。《我们是家庭》探讨了这样一种可能性：我们生活的家庭越多样化，我们就越痴迷于家庭神话，以及媒体上经常描绘的故事。家庭不是一个静态的机构，而必须被理解为一个具有悠久历史和政治的想象结构。
reviews.translated_content: Students who are still choosing Common Core courses, look here!!! I recommend a superb CC course: CCHU9088: We are Family: Myths, Realities and the Future of an Idea (Sem 2, Wed, 12:30–14:20). The lecturer teaches very well. The class content is easy to understand, substantial, and interesting. The grading is fair and generous, and the professor is super easy to communicate with. Questions (whether by email or in person) are answered promptly and in detail. The professor has other good CC courses (such as Motherhood...). Since this is a new course, enrolment is relatively low. Seize the opportunity to enrol in this new course before it becomes highly sought-after in the future. ❤️❤️❤️ Introduction: Today, we are told that “family values” are under serious threat. Fewer people are marrying, divorce is easier, and more children are being born into single-parent families. Wars have displaced many families, forcing them to migrate continuously. We are told that the ideal of the nuclear family is outdated. Multi-generational families, single-parent families, queer families, and child-free families are becoming increasingly popular globally. We Are Family explores the possibility that the more diverse the families we live in become, the more obsessed we become with family myths and the stories often depicted in the media. The family is not a static institution but must be understood as an imagined structure with a long history and politics.

reviews.content:
一门我以为A range势在必得的课，结果来说只拿了B。内容主要涉及道德、社会学、心理学，对哲学非常浅尝辄止的触及了一点点。必须要读的东西其实不算多，中西方的名著摘读以及一些比较新的读物。每次上课时会收上周布置的针对阅读材料的问题，每节Lecture形式是开头先放一个流行乐或者很新潮的视频，然后引发本节topic，然后会有1~2次和教授以及同学交流的时间，接着大部分时间都是教授结合上周读物的总结性和系统性概述念ppt。形式和幻灯片其实有点点死板（但文科好像都是这样？）应该是要自己记笔记的，我们这届好像没有release slides。tutorial形式主要是discussion，要提前准备论据，积极发言基本都可以拿分。workload和分数占比较大的是一个final Essay，一个是3分钟的视频essay。（我是死在视频上了。 明明很费心剪辑、配乐、选素材和打磨的文案，结果tutor Brandon给我了个C，原因至今未解之谜）
个人来说的话，虽然这门课拿了B（上过的5门文科cc里我唯一一门下A的），但我还是想给这门课好评。课堂形式虽然有些枯燥、虽然涉及中国古典名著的阅读材料对于内地来的我更是难蚌（庄子、论语啥的），但是还是在lecture和tutorial上认识了很要好的的同学（坐我后边的女生聊得很来，我能一直参与课堂和加入讨论很大程度要感谢她哈哈哈）、Carl和Brandon也很风趣亲切，非常欢迎课间找他们唠嗑。Carl之前曾是伟伦堂的层主（6楼跟我所在的12楼），曾主办过每学期2~3次的Port&Philosophy，还挺有趣的。Brandon则是30岁带娃只用FB不用ins的奶爸，虽然给了我视频作业C让我怀恨在心，但是个好人（？），他对tutorial的话题引导很值得学习，观点点评也一针见血。

另外很感谢这个课让我认识了圣杯骑士这部电影。
reviews.translated_content: A course where I thought an A-range grade was a sure thing, but I only got a B in the end. The content mainly involves ethics, sociology, and psychology, with only a superficial touch on philosophy. The required reading isn’t actually that much, consisting of excerpts from Chinese and Western classics and some newer readings. Each class starts by collecting answers to questions assigned the previous week regarding the reading materials. Each lecture begins with a pop song or trendy video to introduce the topic, followed by 1–2 opportunities to interact with the professor and classmates. Then, most of the time is spent on the professor reading through PPT slides that provide a summary and systematic overview combined with the previous week’s readings. The format and slides are a bit rigid (but maybe humanities courses are all like this?). You probably need to take your own notes; our cohort didn’t seem to have slides released. Tutorials are mainly discussions; prepare arguments in advance, and active participation basically guarantees marks. The workload and grade weight are dominated by a final essay and a 3-minute video essay. (I failed on the video. Despite putting great effort into editing, music, selecting materials, and polishing the script, tutor Brandon gave me a C, the reason for which remains an unsolved mystery.) Personally, although I got a B in this course (the only one below A among the five humanities Common Core courses I’ve taken), I still want to give it a positive review. Although the class format is somewhat dry, and the reading materials involving Chinese classics were hard for me as a mainland student to hold it together (Zhuangzi, Analects, etc.), I still met very close friends in lectures and tutorials (the girl sitting behind me was easy to chat with, and I could participate in class and join discussions largely thanks to her, hahaha). Carl and Brandon are also humorous and approachable, very welcoming of chats during breaks. Carl used to be a floor headmaster in Wei Lun Hall (6th floor, compared to my 12th floor) and hosted Port & Philosophy events 2–3 times per semester, which were quite interesting. Brandon is a dad in his 30s with kids, using only FB and not Ins. Although he gave me a C on the video assignment, leaving me holding a grudge, he’s a good person (?). His guidance on tutorial topics is worth learning from, and his comments on viewpoints are spot-on. Also, many thanks to this course for introducing me to the film The Holy Grail Knight.

reviews.translated_content: Preachy white guy at a middle-school level. A meaningless, low-workload course with average grading. Do not take it.

reviews.content: 个人观感是体验不太好但分不错的课。具体几个方面来说：1.wl: 可大可小，取决于你对reading到底什么态度。每次课前要交从reading中提出的问题，但tutor给大多数问题都批过了。如果想水五分钟看下文章也不是不行，如果想真的读懂读完那就没上限了。每节课后要写reflection,应该是有打分的。最后一个essay一个video,都是独立完成，工作量还好。2. 课程：这是让我体验感不太好的最大原因，lecturer的授课框架没有什么体系，基本是各种哲学流派+心灵鸡汤的混合。上课自由讨论又占去了很大的时间，讲课的部分lecurer自顾自地念教案，我每次都云里雾里，不知道是他思想太深刻我们无法理解还是他就没打算好好教这门课。但tutorial是非常有趣的，可以结合生活实际聊一聊relationships,大家偶尔会观点碰撞也很有意思，不过想真正学点哲学还是不可能。3. 给分：我个人有A，由于一直没有小分也不知道各部分怎么样。据说是tutor手松（reflection, video),lecturer给的严（essay). 总体来说给分是fair的吧。
reviews.translated_content: My personal impression is that the experience wasn’t great, but the grades were decent. Breaking it down: 1. Workload: It can vary depending on your attitude toward the readings. You have to submit questions from the readings before each class, but the tutor has already marked most of them. If you just want to skim the article for five minutes, that’s fine; if you want to truly understand and finish reading, there’s no upper limit. After each class, you need to write a reflection, which I believe is graded. The last assessment is an essay and a video, both done individually; the workload is manageable. 2. Course: This was the biggest reason for my poor experience. The lecturer’s teaching framework lacks structure; it’s basically a mix of various philosophical schools and chicken-soup-for-the-soul style advice. Free discussion in class takes up a lot of time, and during the lecture parts, the lecturer just reads off the lesson plan. I was confused every time, not sure whether his ideas were too profound for us to understand or if he just didn’t intend to teach the course properly. However, the tutorials are very interesting. You can discuss relationships in real-life contexts, and it’s interesting when viewpoints clash, but don’t expect to really learn philosophy. 3. Grading: I got an A. Since we never received breakdowns, I don’t know how I did in each part. Rumor has it that tutors are lenient with marking (reflections, videos), while the lecturer is strict (essay). Overall, the grading seems fair.

as long as assignments are done on time and the video and essay are done seriously, easy A-range!

reviews.content: 是Sem1唯一的B range。因为是网课所以上课也不是很专注。有group project，individual report以及term quiz。学的统计知识本身不难，exercise会了考试就没问题。report找tutor Jacky改了两稿，tutor很细心负责，可惜所有项的评分最后都在Good一栏。group project也几乎都在Good只有两个Excellent。最后B+
reviews.translated_content: The only B-range grade I got in Sem 1. Since it was an online course, I wasn’t very focused during class. There was a group project, an individual report, and term quizzes. The statistical knowledge itself isn’t difficult; if you understand the exercises, the exam is no problem. I asked my tutor Jacky to review two drafts of my report; he was very careful and responsible. Unfortunately, all components were graded in the “Good” band in the end. The group project was also mostly “Good,” with only two “Excellent” ratings. Final grade: B+.

reviews.content: 这学期第一次开设online CC的形式，一个大好评！在北美交换时候上的，目标水CC。有时差所以lecture大多水水过了，没开摄像头，有时候看着看着就睡着了lol；tutorial jacky很有耐心，大三老人觉得课有点太基础了（但是作为水CC的难度很好），project好好做，期中拿到report以为要B了，最后A-
reviews.translated_content: This was the first time the online Common Core format was offered this semester; big thumbs up! I took it while on exchange in North America, aiming for an easy Common Core course. Due to the time difference, I mostly coasted through the lectures without turning on my camera, and sometimes I fell asleep while watching lol. The tutor, Jacky, was very patient. As a third-year senior, I found the course a bit too basic (but the difficulty was perfect for an easy Common Core). If you put effort into the project, you will do well. When I received my midterm report, I thought I would get a B, but I ended up with an A-.

course_info.requirement: 无前置要求或未提供相关数据

reviews.content: 居然没有人写过这节课的评价。很后悔，当初不该因为是线上课所以无脑选。因为是大学上的第一个cc，所以不清楚wl算不算大：一共2次online forum，4篇200字的reflective memo，1篇400字的initial essay，1篇1200-1500的final essay还有1个group project。不太清楚participation怎么量化给分的，因为两次online forum算在了参与度里。小组只能和同tutorial段的人组，组员不太好。reflective memo和essay得分都不算差，估计是group project太烂导致最后直接B-，算烂🐢。
reviews.translated_content: Surprisingly, no one has written a review for this course yet. I regret it; I shouldn’t have blindly chosen it just because it was an online class. Since it was the first Common Core course I took at university, I’m not sure if the workload counts as heavy: there were 2 online forums, 4 reflective memos of 200 words each, 1 initial essay of 400 words, 1 final essay of 1200–1500 words, and 1 group project. I’m not sure how participation was quantified for grading, since the two online forums counted towards participation. Groups could only be formed with people from the same tutorial section, and my teammates weren’t great. My scores for the reflective memos and essays weren’t bad; I estimate that the group project was so poor that it dragged my final grade down to a B-, which is harsh grading.

reviews.content:
内容我个人觉得还可以但是并不能学到什么特别的，而且不知道为什么教着教着变录播了，搞得本来就是online的课更confusing了。。。wl算大吧（我看有人写就不写了，大概就是每1-2周有一个东西要交，都是不难但是麻烦的类型，补充一下，这课有in-class discussion算attendance），个人reflective memo每个都拿满了，然后两个essay大概都是8/10，gp和forum应该都还行，最后A。
总体是一个蛮多琐碎事情要做的课，如果你擅长乱扯/不想final/IB生，那这门课还是可以选的，但是如果你是一个理科生不太爱写东西而是更擅长考试那st其他课会更合适你。
reviews.translated_content: I personally think the content is okay, but you don’t really learn anything special. For some reason, the teaching switched to pre-recorded videos partway through, which made an already online course even more confusing. The workload is fairly heavy (I saw others mention it, so I won’t elaborate; basically there is something due every 1–2 weeks, all manageable but tedious). Note that in-class discussions count towards attendance. I got full marks on every reflective memo, and both essays were around 8/10. The group project and forum participation were decent, and I ended up with an A. Overall, this is a course with many琐碎 (trivial) tasks. If you are good at bluffing your way through writing, want to avoid a final exam, or have an IB background, this course is still an option. But if you are a science student who dislikes writing and is better at exams, other Common Core courses would suit you better.

reviews.content: 课本身有些无聊，wl不能说大，但是因为要做的事情很多所以非常杂碎、麻烦。平时的课我听的不是很认真，但是tasks都很认真的在对待。上课的时候可以多发言，让tutor记住你（tutor Gordon人很好！），并且发言也是记入participation分的。我reflective memo几乎都在8/10左右，gp在大家都选择做poster的情况下和朋友一起做了个比较有创意的video，最后的final essay自认为写的不错，tutor想要的应该是逻辑清晰，有自己想法的。最后A。
reviews.translated_content: The course itself is a bit boring. The workload isn’t huge, but because there are many tasks, it feels very fragmented and troublesome. I didn’t listen very carefully in class, but I took all the tasks seriously. Speak up more during class so the tutor remembers you (Tutor Gordon is very nice!), and participation marks are awarded for speaking. My reflective memos were mostly around 8/10. For the group project, while most people chose to make a poster, my friend and I made a more creative video. I think my final essay was well-written; the tutor likely values clear logic and original ideas. Final grade: A.

reviews.content: 课堂蛮有趣的 wl不大没有测验没有考试 要写的essay和reflective memo也很容易 确保自己写的时候写多点个人感受和包含ppt的内容就可以了 tutorial多开mic说话发表意见（讨论的东西都很简单的 有一次只是问晒太阳有益吗) group project也不太难 确保队友都不是free rider就好 轻松A grade
reviews.translated_content: The classes are quite interesting. The workload isn’t heavy; there are no tests or exams. The essay and reflective memo are easy to write; just make sure to include plenty of personal reflections and content from the slides. In tutorials, speak up often into the mic to share your opinions (the discussion topics are very simple; once it was just asking whether sunbathing is beneficial). The group project isn’t too difficult either; just ensure none of your teammates are free riders. An easy A grade.

reviews.content: This course is super abstract like I basically participated in all tutorials got 8/10 for many of my reflective memo/essays and still ended up with B so not sure their grading basis

reviews.content: 内容我个人觉得还可以但是并不能学到什么特别的，而且不知道为什么教着教着变录播了，搞得本来就是online的课更confusing了。。。wl算大吧
reviews.translated_content: I personally think the content is okay, but you don’t really learn anything special. Also, for some reason, the teaching turned into pre-recorded videos partway through, which made an already online course even more confusing... The workload is quite heavy.

reviews.content: 非常非常好的cc 水课 ，基本上没有听课，最后grade a+。online的课其实上了一个小时左右就结束弄当堂测验，ai可以解决。wl不大，记得是一个individual essay1000字左右，一个资料摘抄，一个group essay ，一个group presentation，老师给分松，而且改essay也给分高（毕竟是理科老师），反正盲选都很值💗
reviews.translated_content: A very, very good Common Core lightweight course. I basically did not attend the classes and still got an A+ in the end. For the online classes, they essentially ended after about an hour to conduct an in-class quiz, which AI can solve. The workload is not heavy. I recall there was one individual essay of about 1000 words, one data extraction task, one group essay, and one group presentation. The instructor grades leniently, and essays are also marked generously (after all, they are science teachers). Anyway, it is well worth taking even if you choose blindly 💗.

reviews.content: wl非常小，gp找個好隊友，平時assignment認真做，最後出來grade都不會差。
reviews.translated_content: The workload is very light. Find good teammates for the group project, do the regular assignments seriously, and your final grade won’t be bad.

reviews.content: 两小时lecture就上半小时做个小测就可以see you next time了，两篇文章一篇写个几百字一篇收集新闻点评个200字就完事了，小组essay和pre有点麻烦，总体还是体验很好滴
reviews.translated_content: A two-hour lecture lasts only half an hour, followed by a short quiz, and then you can say ‘see you next time.’ For the two articles, one requires writing a few hundred words, and the other involves collecting news items and writing a 200-word commentary—that’s it. The group essay and presentation are a bit troublesome, but overall the experience was very good.

reviews.content: 好grade 好grade！冲！一个简单的individual essay（100/100）、一个比较容易的找资料（14/15）、一个比较大的project （group essay9.75/15和group pre没有数据）。
reviews.translated_content: Good grade, good grade! Go for it! There was a simple individual essay (100/100), a relatively easy research task (14/15), and a larger project (group essay 9.75/15 and no data for the group presentation).

reviews.content: wl超级小！！！！强推！但是一定一定要提前找好靠谱队友，我因为第一个学期不了解结果跟两个不靠谱的free rider local一起作业和in class worksheet都是a+但是gp拖累了最后a-
reviews.translated_content: The workload is super small!!!! Highly recommended! But you must find reliable teammates in advance. Because I didn’t understand the situation in the first semester, I ended up with two unreliable local free riders. Although my assignments and in-class worksheets were all A+, the group project dragged my final grade down to an A-.

reviews.content: Wl巨小的好🐢课，随便搞搞就能拿A😋
reviews.translated_content: A GPA-friendly course with a tiny workload; you can easily get an A just by putting in minimal effort 😋

reviews.content: wl还行，找好队友很重要。个人作业assignment 1 79/100，文章收集assignment 2满分，gp队友不干活，pre D+, gp essay 35/100，最后grade B-
reviews.translated_content: The workload is manageable, but finding good teammates is crucial. I scored 79/100 on Assignment 1 (individual), got full marks on Assignment 2 (article collection), received a D+ on the presentation because my group project teammates didn’t contribute, scored 35/100 on the group project essay, and ended up with a B-.

reviews.content: 作业和lecture讲的东西相关性不高，不过lec很轻松，基本上半小时就下课了。Assignment 1比较对胃口，99/100，assignment 2很无聊，不是很高，gp队友比较给力，gp合作很好，最后A range。
reviews.translated_content: The assignments don’t correlate highly with what’s covered in the lectures, but the lectures are very relaxed and basically end after half an hour. Assignment 1 suited me well (99/100), while Assignment 2 was boring and my score wasn’t very high. My group project teammates were quite helpful, so the collaboration went well, and I ended up with an A-range grade.

reviews.content: wl小 gp占比大找好队友比较重要
reviews.translated_content: The workload is light. The group project carries a large weight, so finding good teammates is quite important.

reviews.content: 啥都不说了 水课必吃榜这门课必有一席！🙏🏻好课好课
reviews.translated_content: Needless to say, this course definitely deserves a spot on the must-take list for easy courses! 🙏🏻 Great course, great course.

reviews.content: WL很小，gpt就可以解决很多任务，拿A-很容易
reviews.translated_content: The workload is very light. GPT can handle many of the tasks, so it’s easy to get an A-.

reviews.content: 没什么难度，上上网课分就到手，最难的也就tutorial上辩论。
reviews.translated_content: Not much difficulty. You can get the grade just by attending the online classes. The hardest part is the debate in the tutorial.

reviews.content: grade一般b+，以为会更高分，平时网课是预制课笑死，我一个视频都没看，视频是老师两年前youtube录好的，只不过去每节课都有小测之类的（ai帮忙）或者是forum回答问题（也是ai帮忙，我就是要被ai代替的人笑死😆），tutor感觉一般没有友好，wl挺小的，就是gp一个video，还有自己一篇individual essay或者做poster介绍crowdfunding video的新app，总体就还好，就是想着网课来逃课的
reviews.translated_content: The grade was average, a B+. I expected a higher score. The online lectures were pre-recorded, which was laughable; I didn’t watch a single video. The videos were recorded by the teacher on YouTube two years ago. However, every class had small quizzes (done with AI help) or forum questions to answer (also with AI help; I’m basically being replaced by AI, lol 😆). The tutor felt average and not particularly friendly. The workload was quite light: just a group project involving one video, plus either an individual essay or a poster introducing a new app for crowdfunding videos. Overall it was just okay; I only took it because I thought an online course would let me skip attending.

reviews.content: 绝世好课，教授给了47%的a range
reviews.translated_content: An absolutely fantastic course. The professor gave 47% of the class an A-range grade.

reviews.content: workload 小到不能再小，第一天就挑明了“你好我好大家好”的原则。给分非常不错，AI无基础应该也能轻松高分。平时的周常作业全部满分，group project 找了个不认识的同学一起普通地完成，tutorial全部都去了，debate正正常常，最后A
reviews.translated_content: The workload couldn’t be lighter. On the first day, the principle of ‘everyone gets along and does well’ was made clear. Grading is very generous; even students with no background in AI should be able to score highly with ease. I got full marks on all weekly assignments. For the group project, I partnered with a classmate I didn’t know and we completed it adequately. I attended all tutorials, performed normally in the debate, and ended up with an A.

reviews.content: 非常小wl，cc课里面算很好龟了
reviews.translated_content: Very low workload; among Common Core courses, the grading is quite generous.

reviews.content: 非常好的课，wl很小非常适合交换期间上

course_info.title: Quantitative Literacy in Science, Technology and Society

reviews.content: 烂了 选课的时候被评价忽悠了 我自己上下来（包括几个朋友）都是 b range. 这门课的统计知识很浅，比stat那几门基础课还浅，基本就是常识。上课内容很水，tut每周2h，时间很长，有用的基本都在tut. 有一个论坛作业，一个gp，一个quiz，一个essay. 这个真的好玄学，我们组做的很努力 ，但是tutor评价很低。最让人无语的是quiz，题目难度不大，但是考完我一对答案，发现tutor有好几个答案给错了。从统计知识讲，学过1600的同学会发现lec和tut有不少知识点讲的不对（可见老师水平一般，个人觉得还不如统计系得新生）. 总之这是一门比较玄学的课 不建议上 run.
reviews.translated_content: It was a disaster. I was misled by the reviews when selecting the course. My friends and I all ended up with B-range grades. The statistical knowledge in this course is very shallow, even shallower than the introductory STAT courses; it’s basically common sense. The lecture content is lightweight. Tutorials are two hours long every week, which is quite lengthy, but the useful material is mostly in the tutorials. There is one forum assignment, one group project, one quiz, and one essay. The grading for these is really opaque and unpredictable. Our group worked very hard, but the tutor gave us a low evaluation. The most speechless part was the quiz: the questions weren’t difficult, but after checking my answers, I found that the tutor had marked several answers incorrectly. From a statistical perspective, students who have taken STAT1600 will notice that many points in the lectures and tutorials are explained incorrectly (which shows the instructor’s level is average; personally, I think they’re worse than a freshman in the Statistics Department). In short, this is a rather unpredictable course. I don’t recommend taking it—stay away.

reviews.content: gp分到了一个全是不怎么积极的local的组烂了，但individual report和quiz算是力挽狂澜吧。tutor jacky人不错，会很热心的帮助学生解决问题，帮我改了一半individual report。最后的quiz就是很基础的数学/统计知识，本社科人完全可以handle
reviews.translated_content: For the group project, I was assigned to a group full of unengaged local students, so it went badly. But the individual report and quizzes helped me make up for it. The tutor, Jacky, is nice and enthusiastically helps students solve problems; he even helped me edit half of my individual report. The final quiz covers very basic maths/stats knowledge, which someone from a social sciences background like me can handle easily.

reviews.content: 内容一般 挺水的
reviews.translated_content: The content is average and quite lightweight.

reviews.content: Very helpful course. Tutor is also nice
reviews.translated_content: Very helpful course. Tutor is also nice

reviews.content: tutor nice， 给分很好
reviews.translated_content: The tutor is nice, and the grading is generous.

reviews.content: 没怎么去听课，但是tutor非常非常nice。group project的时候直接把大陆人和香港人分成两组，还和我们说普通话！给分也很好，课程对于学统计数学的来说基本没什么难度。推荐！
reviews.translated_content: I didn't attend many classes, but the tutor was very, very nice. During the group project, they even split the mainland students and Hong Kong students into two groups and spoke Mandarin with us! Grading is also very good. For those studying statistics or mathematics, the course is basically not difficult at all. Recommended!

reviews.content: 这课其实是教育学院开的，和数统真的没啥关系，教的是一些科学的…思想？方法…和实际生活的联系？个人感觉倒也没有太水，细品一下还是有点东西的。考试简单，gp 队友给力，最后a range。
reviews.translated_content: This course is actually offered by the Faculty of Education and has little to do with mathematics and statistics. It teaches some scientific... ways of thinking? Methods... and their connection to real life? Personally, I don’t feel it’s too superficial; if you think about it carefully, there is some substance. The exam is simple. My group project teammates were helpful, and I ended up with an A-range grade.

reviews.content: wl不大，给🐢一般，有final有report有gp，gp只能找同一个tutorial的人，如果有认识的人可以和tutor讲想在一组
reviews.translated_content: The workload isn't heavy. The grading is average. There is a final exam, a report, and a group project. For the group project, you can only form a group with people from the same tutorial section. If you know someone you want to work with, you can talk to the tutor about being in the same group.

reviews.content: 可以水lecture的好龟课！内容和stat1600很像，tutor超级好呜呜呜；有个gp和individual report，期末有个2h的quiz，最后A
reviews.translated_content: An easy course where you can coast through lectures and still get a good grade! The content is very similar to STAT1600, and the tutor is super nice. There’s a group project and an individual report, plus a 2-hour quiz at the end. I got an A.

reviews.content: wl小，不take attendance，quiz简单，essay短 1200字，gp也还好，hea读有A-是很满意的了
reviews.translated_content: Low workload, no attendance taking, easy quizzes, short essay (1200 words), and the group project was okay. Coasting through it and getting an A- was very satisfying.

reviews.content:
非常好的课，爱来自MBBS， 水了一学期，group project没做，presentation 被组友赶走没做，essay
50%deduction,最后成功拿到d的好成绩，总gpa高达1.9，感谢9006，感谢Joana ho
reviews.translated_content: An excellent course. Love from an MBBS student. I coasted through the semester, didn’t do the group project, got kicked out of my group so I didn’t do the presentation, and had 50% deducted from my essay. In the end, I successfully ended up with a D, bringing my overall GPA to a lofty 1.9. Thanks to CCST9006, and thanks to Joana ho.

reviews.content: 超级好的一门课了！特别推荐有生物背景的同学上，没有的话也可以 因为解释都挺清楚！如果你是mbbs/bds那就直接冲吧课程内容完全重叠iasm！上课内容根本可以说是没有额外workload。tutorial是跟在lecture后面的，与其说是tutorial不如说是延长了lecture哈哈没有特别的活动。lecture会带有google doc小组讨论，作业就是两三篇短essay，最后一个group poster和individual reflection。真的好🐢大推荐！
reviews.translated_content: This is a super good course! Highly recommended for students with a biology background, but it’s fine without one too because the explanations are quite clear. If you’re in MBBS/BDS, just go for it—the course content completely overlaps with IASM! The lecture content essentially means no extra workload. The tutorial follows the lecture; rather than a tutorial, it’s more like an extended lecture, haha, with no special activities. Lectures include Google Doc group discussions. Assignments are two or three short essays, plus a final group poster and individual reflection. Really great grades. Highly recommended!

reviews.content: 强烈安利！！！！！！必须安利！！！！几个老师真的都超级无敌可爱并且无比认真负责，尤其是William（现在都sem2了还在给我们发feedback，详细介绍“我觉得你们很容易弄错”的一些概念，超级nice！课程内容很有趣（不仅内容有趣方式也很有趣，老师也很幽默尤其是Stephen Shiu），如果高中有生物基础的话那这门课基本上就是英语课了（学习专用名词的英语）。有几个自愿参加的实验。唯一的一点点难处就是（对我这个英语很差的人来说）生词（英文专业表达）有一点点多，上课得开着翻译软件。总之强烈安利！给分很不错
reviews.translated_content: Highly recommended!!!! Must recommend!!!! The instructors are all super cute and incredibly responsible, especially William (it’s already Sem 2 and he’s still sending us feedback, explaining in detail some concepts he thinks we easily get wrong—super nice!). The course content is interesting (not just the content but also the delivery, and the instructors are humorous, especially Stephen Shiu). If you have a high school biology background, this course is basically an English class (learning the English terminology). There are a few voluntary lab sessions. The only slight difficulty is that there are quite a few new words (English technical expressions), so you need to have translation software open during class. Anyway, highly recommended! The grading is quite generous.

reviews.content: run！！！！！给分究极玄学 本人essay 接近满分 高考生物98/100 生物竞赛省一 差两分进省队 结果这个玄学课拿了个B😅 遇到local freerider了 体验感极差（实名上网了 哈哈
reviews.translated_content: Run!!!!! The grading is utterly opaque and unpredictable. My essay was nearly full marks, I scored 98/100 in Biology in the Gaokao, won first prize at the provincial level in the Biology Olympiad, and missed making the provincial team by just two points. Yet I ended up with a B in this unpredictable course 😅. I also encountered a local free rider. The experience was terrible (I’m naming names online, haha).

reviews.content: lecture 很无聊，🐢最后也一般，B+，不过也确实没太认真听讲所以这个分也接受了。单纯为了🐢可以来试试，但是要做好每周浪费3个小时的准备。
reviews.translated_content: Lectures are very boring, and the final grade was just average, a B+. But I also didn't listen very attentively, so I accept this grade. You can try it if you're just after the grade, but be prepared to waste 3 hours every week.

reviews.content: lecture很无聊
reviews.translated_content: The lectures are very boring.

reviews.content: workload较小，总共4篇reflection，期末group project做海报和presentation（医学院的大神可能会把group project carry掉 课上会用Google doc进行group discussion，口语不好的同学完全不用担心。会讨论很多social issue，ethical issue，不全是专业内容。还有一些有趣的小实验。 最后A-。  推荐！
reviews.translated_content: The workload is relatively light, with four reflections in total. The final assessment is a group project involving a poster and a presentation (very strong students from the Faculty of Medicine might carry the group project). Group discussions are conducted using Google Docs in class, so students who are not confident in spoken English don't need to worry at all. We discuss many social and ethical issues, not just professional content. There are also some interesting small experiments. I got an A-. Highly recommended!

reviews.content: wl小，不太看组友，主要讨论生物科学在伦理道德方面的问题，有点哲学的味，滑水A-
reviews.translated_content: Low workload. It doesn’t depend much on teammates. The main focus is discussing ethical issues in biological sciences, with a bit of a philosophical flavour. Coasted to an A-.

reviews.content: wl不算大，約4-5篇短文，一項設計海報的小組作業presentation，以及一份2000字的個人report. 課程主要討論前沿或未來生物醫學技術造成的道德、社會爭議，例如人造子宮、換頭手術、冬眠技術等。授課老師是幾位醫學院的教授，十分風趣. 每堂課都會有隨堂討論，在Google doc上和組員碼字討論，然後每組抽取幾人和教授互動回答問題。認真完成所有作業，最後A-
reviews.translated_content: The workload isn’t heavy: about 4–5 short articles, one group assignment involving designing a poster and presenting, and a 2000-word individual report. The course mainly discusses ethical and social controversies caused by cutting-edge or future biomedical technologies, such as artificial wombs, head transplants, and hibernation technology. The instructors are several professors from the Faculty of Medicine, and they are very humorous. Every class has in-class discussions where you type out discussions with your group members on Google Docs, and then a few people from each group are selected to interact with the professor and answer questions. If you complete all assignments seriously, you can get an A-.

reviews.content: 好🐢课🥹教授任非常nice尤其是William，属于有问必答，回邮件也非常迅速！！没有final，重点评分是reflection essay和一个group poster，wl非常小且没有生物背景也可以上，好课推荐
reviews.translated_content: A GPA-friendly course 🥹. The professors are very nice, especially William, who answers every question and replies to emails very quickly!! There is no final exam. The main assessments are a reflection essay and a group poster. The workload is very light, and you can take it even without a biology background. Recommended course.
