search_summary.title: The Metaverse: From Human Vision to Extended Reality

course_info.title: The Metaverse: From Human Vision to Extended Reality

reviews.content: 良心课！前半部分讲人类视觉（眼睛/大脑/视觉误差等等），后半部分机器视觉（摄影/deep learning等），对文科生会有点难，不过认真学是一定能学明白的。workload有点大，两篇reading assignment（看report回答问题），一个group presentation（5-6人 每人的part只有2分钟），mid-term 还有final。开卷考试导致题目变的注重理解，只看ppt不够，还需要仔细听老师讲的，包括同学的提问。professor人帅而且负责，lecture是重点。我有炒鸡认真的学，最后A+
reviews.translated_content: A genuinely worthwhile course! The first half covers human vision (eyes/brain/visual illusions, etc.), and the second half covers machine vision (photography/deep learning, etc.). It might be a bit difficult for humanities students, but if you study seriously, you can definitely understand it. The workload is a bit heavy: two reading assignments (answering questions based on reports), one group presentation (5–6 people, each person’s part is only 2 minutes), a midterm, and a final. The open-book format makes the questions focus more on understanding; just looking at PPTs isn’t enough—you need to listen carefully to what the professor says, including students’ questions. The professor is handsome and responsible; lectures are key. I studied super diligently and got an A+.

reviews.content: 课程wl不大，tutorial也不会让发很多言，只要take attendence就行， 还有一个presentation但是得分挺高的！推荐 只要平时听了课就可以很高分
reviews.translated_content: The course workload isn’t heavy, and tutorials don’t require much speaking; you just need to take attendance. There’s also a presentation, but the marks are quite high! Recommended. As long as you listen in class, you can get a very high score.

reviews.content: 挺不错的，特殊时期网课，只要在考前复习一下lecture就行了。网上的presentation也挺顺利。总体体验不错
reviews.translated_content: It’s quite good. During the special period of online classes, you just need to review the lectures before the exams. The online presentations went smoothly too. Overall, a good experience.

reviews.content: wl巨大 考试恶心 不只是认真背就能得高分 所幸组到好组友（随机分组） 给分还不错 总之如果害怕gp或者自学能力/动手操作能力一般般不是很建议选
reviews.translated_content: The workload is huge, and the exam is unpleasant. It’s not just about memorising thoroughly to get a high score. Fortunately, I was randomly grouped with good teammates. The grading is decent. In short, if you’re worried about the group project or if your self-study and hands-on skills are just average, I wouldn’t highly recommend this course.

reviews.content: 课程在我学的时候有改动，新加的metaverse部分感兴趣会很有意思。内容大概是两个quiz 40%，1porj，essay，造房子。没有生物背景第一个quiz会比较吃力，认真听了但是听不懂，但是dirk很好人，你可以每一页ppt都问他，虽然我最后quiz分数比mean还低。proj和建模给分极高，我建模在chur ddl的时候大概一小时赶出来的也有B+。好在我第二个quiz嘎嘎乱杀，最后拿了A-。quiz和proj核心考点就是你对知识的理解，准备一下且没有大是大非的错基本上不会差。总之对metaverse，vr，blockchain，NFT这些感兴趣的可以读，会很轻松，不需要有任何技术背景
reviews.translated_content: The course structure changed while I was taking it; the newly added Metaverse section is quite interesting if you’re into it. The assessment breakdown is roughly two quizzes (40%), one project, an essay, and a ‘build a house’ task. Without a biology background, the first quiz will be tough; I listened carefully but still didn’t understand much. Dirk is very nice, though—you can ask him about every single PowerPoint slide. Even so, my first quiz score was below the mean. The project and modelling components are graded very generously; I rushed my modelling in about an hour right before the demanding deadline and still got a B+. Fortunately, I absolutely crushed the second quiz, and ended up with an A-. The core of both the quizzes and the project is your understanding of the material; if you prepare and avoid major errors, you should do fine. In short, if you’re interested in the Metaverse, VR, blockchain, NFTs, etc., you can take this course. It will feel easy, and no technical background is required.

reviews.content: Dirk上课特别有趣；assessment的种类还挺多：2个quiz，一个gp，一篇1500essay议论文，一个造房子建模的视频；forum和attendence有5%的bonus分。今年后半部分讲metaverse是老师新加的。会讲人类眼睛（眼睛的构造、视觉有关的原理和理论），包括一些很有趣的视觉trick。后面介绍neural network、blockchain、web3等，不会特别难。tutor还会让我们用ai作画，大家投票，前几名有Dirk的hku小熊大熊奖品呜呜呜狠狠羡慕
reviews.translated_content: Dirk’s classes are particularly interesting. There is quite a variety of assessments: two quizzes, one group project, one 1500-word argumentative essay, and a video on building modelling. Forum participation and attendance give a 5% bonus. The second half of the course this year covered the metaverse, which was newly added by the teacher. He talks about the human eye (structure, principles and theories related to vision), including some interesting visual tricks. Later, he introduces neural networks, blockchain, Web3, etc., which are not particularly difficult. The tutor also let us use AI to create images, and we voted on them. The top winners received HKU bear prizes from Dirk. I’m so envious.

reviews.content: load大。今年enroll的绝大部分是内地生，卷，分不好。前半部分讲大脑与感知，就像在讲八股文，背背背…
reviews.translated_content: Heavy load. Most of the students enrolled this year are from Mainland China, so it’s highly competitive and grades are not good. The first half covers the brain and perception, which feels like rote learning—just memorize, memorize, memorize…

reviews.content: quiz变难了，增加了group video的wl，grade也变差了：）去年是新开的课所以啥都好 现在可能已经不是了......
reviews.translated_content: The quizzes have become more difficult, the workload for the group video has increased, and the grading has gotten worse :) Last year it was a newly launched course so everything was great; now that might no longer be the case...

reviews.content: 前半部分是human vision，讲人类如何感知各种颜色，疯狂解释各种视觉错觉背后的科学道理；后半截是machine vision，显而易见的围绕机器学习等内容。wl不太大，可以玩到vr眼镜（错重点
reviews.translated_content: The first half covers human vision, explaining how humans perceive various colours and thoroughly unpacking the science behind visual illusions; the second half is about machine vision, obviously focusing on machine learning and related topics. The workload isn’t heavy, and you get to try VR headsets (though that’s missing the point).

reviews.content: 老师很认真负责，要好好组队
reviews.translated_content: The instructor is very serious and responsible. Make sure to form your group carefully.

reviews.translated_content: Maybe the instructor changed in recent years? The workload is still very small, but the essay grading is harsh. The presentation was okay, but I only got a B in the end. Everyone, choose with caution.

reviews.content: 好好准备gp就没有问题。
reviews.translated_content: If you prepare well for the group project, there won’t be any problems.

reviews.content: 上过最nice的cc之一！workload巨小，给分巨好（全组都a及以上），唯一的缺点是学不到东西 科科。课程只有一点点跟tech和engineering相关的东西（包括一次很水的lab），可以随便了解一下，assessment核心在AI对人类的影响及二者关系的思考。lecture非常水，随便听听；lecturer人非常nice；tutorial基本不需要准备。wl方面：有一个prez：1.老师会多次跟进，tuto上可以准备，不花费太多其他时间 2. prez的topic最好不要大篇幅讲技术相关的，让老师觉得有趣比较重要 3.这门课local多，有没有靠谱小伙伴还是很重要的。还有一篇essay：字数要求好像蛮多，极力推荐编小说，不用查资料，不用担心写了废话，可以加上一点自己熟悉领域的专业知识忽悠一下tutor。overall，可以边水边刷分的好课。
reviews.translated_content: One of the nicest Common Core courses I’ve taken! The workload is tiny, and grading is extremely generous (everyone in our group got an A or above). The only downside is that you don’t really learn much academically. The course touches only briefly on tech and engineering topics (including one very lightweight lab), so you can just get a general idea. The core of the assessment focuses on reflecting on AI’s impact on humanity and the relationship between the two. Lectures are very superficial—just listen casually; the lecturer is very nice. Tutorials basically require no preparation. Workload-wise: there is one presentation: 1. The teacher follows up multiple times, and you can prepare during tutorials without spending much extra time. 2. It’s better not to focus your presentation topic heavily on technical aspects; making it interesting to the teacher is more important. 3. There are many local Hong Kong students in this course, so having reliable teammates is quite important. There is also one essay: the word count requirement seems quite high. I strongly recommend writing a fictional story; you don’t need to research sources or worry about padding, and you can sprinkle in some professional knowledge from your own field to impress the tutor. Overall, it’s a good course where you can coast while boosting your GPA.

reviews.content: 总体还不错，感觉课上内容和assignment关联不大（可划水的那种），prof和tutor都挺好的，好龟
reviews.translated_content: Overall quite good. I felt the lecture content wasn’t closely related to the assignments (the kind where you can coast), and both the professor and tutor were nice. Generous grading.

reviews.content: workload巨小，🐢好，第一个教授挺nice的。
reviews.translated_content: The workload is tiny, the grading is generous, and the first professor is quite nice.

reviews.content: strongly recommended!

reviews.content: wl真不大，但是🐢烂，啊啊啊啊啊
reviews.translated_content: The workload is really not heavy, but the grading is poor, ahhhhh.

course_info.title: The Ecology of War

reviews.content: 慎选，我是summer sem上的，课程内容不错但是一个group video占40%，而且老师给分我个人感到也蛮随意的，听很多同学说都给的比较低，不太推荐
reviews.translated_content: Choose with caution. I took it in the summer semester. The course content is good, but a group video accounts for 40%, and I personally felt the instructor’s grading was rather arbitrary. I heard from many classmates that grades were generally low, so I don’t really recommend it.

reviews.content: 慎选！tutor给龟非常chur，video和educational display给分都很离谱，只要不符合他的喜好，根本不会考虑小组的efforts，可能直接1/10。而且给分非常主观，根本不考虑拍摄时客观条件的局限。同时平时分占比非常细碎不好拿全，而且总量低(40%)，主观评分的部分（比如视频和educational display的最终呈现）占比很高(60%)。所以就会导致你兢兢业业一个暑假，其他所有的作业都认真完成，因为gp的视频虽然没有技术问题，也没有敷衍，但是不讨他喜欢，就拿一个很低的分数，最终导致龟很难看。千万慎重，慎重！
reviews.translated_content: Choose with caution! The tutor’s grading is extremely strict. The marks for the video and educational display are ridiculous; if something doesn’t align with his personal preferences, he won’t consider the group’s effort at all and might give as low as 1/10. The grading is highly subjective and ignores objective limitations during filming. Meanwhile, the continuous assessment marks are fragmented and hard to maximize, and the total weight is low (40%), while the subjectively graded components (such as the final presentation of the video and educational display) carry a high weight (60%). As a result, you could work diligently throughout the summer and complete all other assignments seriously, but if your group project video—despite having no technical issues and not being done perfunctorily—simply doesn’t appeal to him, you’ll receive a very low score. This will ultimately ruin your grade. Please be very careful!

reviews.content: 跟留言一樣建議慎選，在summer跟朋友一起上的一門課，課程內容挺有趣的，混合了世界歷史，生物和地理的知識去解釋一些歷史的戰爭如何影響到生物的棲息地。group video有一部分是老師分別給每個組員給分，主要是評核在影片裡的語調和講稿內容。在分組那裡其中一個朋友沒能選上同一個tutorial時間所以沒有同組，所以也見證了老師給分很迷。自己組的video跟別人組的內容和鋪排差不多，但是grade最後卻相差很遠。 最後grade B-，敗在video上，其他部分的評分拿了九成以上的分數 朋友們拿的grade由A到B-的都有
reviews.translated_content: As other comments suggest, choose with caution. I took this course in the summer with a friend. The content was quite interesting, blending world history, biology, and geography to explain how historical wars affected biological habitats. For the group video, the instructor graded each member individually, mainly assessing tone and script content in the video. In our group, one friend couldn’t join the same tutorial time, so we weren’t in the same group, and I witnessed how confusing the instructor’s grading could be. Our group’s video was similar in content and structure to others’, but the final grades differed significantly. I ended up with a B-, losing marks on the video, while scoring over 90% on other components. My friends’ grades ranged from A to B-.

reviews.content: 刚刚出了grade是B，也是慎选吧。今年workload不大，但是评分完全没有准则，全凭教授主观，video他觉得内容剪接不好creativity就给了个3/10，content4/10，有点莫名其妙，完全辜负我们的付出，花了好几天在外面拍素材，我们也有看过其他组的影片，别人全组在zoom对着ppt和维基百科在念，如果我们只有3分那不知道教授又会给他们多少creativity和content分呢？ 其次oral给了7/10，但comment说 bit inaccurate pronunciation，完全不能理解，从小在外国语学校读书自问不可能犯这种错误，我让荷兰室友帮我听了几次都找不到所谓的发音不准，教授是需要我们用他的澳洲式英语发音才行吗？ 反而Educational display的话只用了一天时间做成绩还行，不然应该连B-也没有
reviews.translated_content: I just got a B. I’d advise choosing this course with caution. The workload this year wasn’t heavy, but the grading had no clear criteria at all; it was entirely up to the professor’s subjective judgment. For the video, he gave 3/10 for creativity because he felt the editing was poor, and 4/10 for content. It was quite baffling and completely failed to recognise our effort. We spent several days shooting footage on location. We also watched other groups’ videos: their entire group just read off PowerPoint slides and Wikipedia on Zoom. If we only got 3 marks, I wonder how much creativity and content credit the professor would give them? Secondly, I got 7/10 for the oral presentation, but the comment said my pronunciation was “a bit inaccurate”. I completely don’t understand this. Having studied at a foreign-language school since childhood, I’m confident I wouldn’t make that kind of mistake. I asked my Dutch roommate to listen several times, and they couldn’t find any so-called mispronunciation. Does the professor expect us to speak with his Australian accent? On the other hand, the Educational display component only took one day to prepare, and the result was decent; otherwise, I probably wouldn’t have even gotten a B-.

reviews.content: A+，夯。感觉改名之后有些内容也换了所以跟之前的评价体验不太一样。个人感觉workload约等于没有，只需要出勤4节tutorial，lecture上的quiz都可以用ai。小作业要用自己的摄影/绘画作品做一个自选hk本地生物的educational display，因为不是每个人都能拍到有关生态保护topic aka可以做点文章的生物高质图片，所以强烈推荐能画就画，Evan不会看你的绘画参考。大作业是一个video，我们组实地去拍了素材最后剪成了类似纪录片的形式。有绘画/摄影/剪辑基础并且对生物or战争topic感兴趣的你就上这课吧一上一个不吱声。

course_info.requirement: Your enrollment must comply with the requirements of Common Core (CC) and your programme. Contact commoncore@hku.hk for enquiries."

reviews.instructor: Dr F.C.C. Ling, Dr M.K. Yip, Dr A.S.Y. Shum
reviews.content: 有趣的課, 主要講 concepts, 沒有需要計算的內容, test 要溫習, 但對physics 不錯的人不難, 中學有讀 physics 的人有優勢 推薦喜歡 physics 的人讀
reviews.translated_content: An interesting course. It mainly focuses on concepts, with no calculation required. You need to revise for the test, but it isn’t difficult for those who are good at physics. Students who studied physics in secondary school have an advantage. Recommended for those who like physics.

reviews.content: 两次inclass test，各占17.5%,第一次简单第二次较难。 另外有一篇1000字的individual essay和一个十分钟的四人prez，各占30%%和25%，内容不难给分较紧。 同意 “ tutor人很好，对essay和presen都提供了很多帮助，并且打分反馈也很及时。assessment剩余部分是tuto participation，去了就可以拿满。” 每个component做好，85分A+。
reviews.translated_content: Two in-class tests, each worth 17.5%. The first was easy, the second harder. There is also a 1,000-word individual essay and a ten-minute four-person presentation, worth 30% and 25% respectively. The content isn’t difficult, but grading is tight. I agree that “the tutor is very nice, provided a lot of help with the essay and presentation, and gave timely feedback on grading. The remaining assessment component is tutorial participation; you get full marks just for attending.” If you do well in each component, you can get 85, an A+.

reviews.content: 好龟课，wl巨小。test注意ppt一定要一页一页认真看，两次test争取都90以上，essay认真写，peer review的时候积极改，拿个高分，a range问题不大。最后a+
reviews.translated_content: A GPA-friendly course with a tiny workload. For the tests, make sure to read the slides carefully page by page; aim for over 90 in both tests. Write the essay seriously, and be proactive in making revisions during peer review to secure a high score. Getting an A-range grade shouldn’t be a problem. I finished with an A+.

reviews.content: Alex tutor is great. The workload is medium. The lecture is a little bit boring. But it is not hard to understand it.
reviews.translated_content: Alex tutor is great. The workload is medium. The lecture is a little bit boring. But it is not hard to understand it.

reviews.content: Alex is a so very nice tutor and lecturer, he makes the tutorials interesting. The course is not hea, to be honest, but because of the multiple assessment components, it's less easily to larn grade.
reviews.translated_content: Alex is a very nice tutor and lecturer; he makes the tutorials interesting. The course is not relaxed, to be honest, but because of the multiple assessment components, it’s less easy to get a good grade.

reviews.content: 对物理有兴趣的朋友可选，考试第一次不难，第二次有点难，不过大家得分都不高就也还好，gp碰到free rider有点烦 不过还是得了不算很差的分
reviews.translated_content: Friends who are interested in physics may consider this course. The first exam wasn’t difficult, but the second one was a bit hard. However, since everyone’s scores were low, it was fine. It was annoying to encounter free riders in the group project, but I still got a not-too-bad grade.

reviews.content: 烂龟课 assessment混乱
reviews.translated_content: Poor grading, and the assessments are disorganised.

reviews.content: DSE 5* 最後 B
reviews.translated_content: DSE 5* ended up with a B.

reviews.content: 太好龟了，整门课的亮点就在于Tutorial，有针对性，幽默风趣，wl极小。Alex人真的超好。高考理科生来刷龟毫无压力，其他背景的同学来上这门课也不会跟不上。唯一缺点是lecture确实不如tutorial，比较干涩无聊。
reviews.translated_content: The grading is extremely generous. The highlight of the entire course is the tutorial, which is targeted, humorous, and witty, with a very light workload. Alex is truly a super nice person. Science students from the Gaokao background can take this course to boost their GPA with no pressure, and students from other backgrounds won’t fall behind either. The only downside is that the lectures are indeed not as good as the tutorials; they are rather dry and boring.

reviews.content: 这门课真的好龟，强烈建议对物理有兴趣的同学选。lecture讲的大部分是高中知识，tutorial很轻松，workload不大。两个test有难度，而且解答题评分标准很迷惑，所有人分都不高，最后拿了A。
reviews.translated_content: This course really has generous grading. I strongly recommend it to students interested in physics. Most of the lecture content is high school level, tutorials are relaxed, and the workload is light. The two tests are difficult, and the marking criteria for structured questions are very confusing; no one scored highly. I still got an A in the end.

reviews.content: 真的难绷，感觉什么都学不到，唯一的优点就是wl真的很低，给分真的不是很好看，这学期唯一一个b range
reviews.translated_content: It’s really baffling. I feel like I learned nothing. The only advantage is that the workload is really low. The grading is really not attractive; this was my only B-range grade this semester.

reviews.content: 莫名其妙B+…本来照着Arange去的 不知道评分标准根本 但说真的也算不错了 几乎无workload这门课存在感很小 lec可以不用去让人帮签到就行 tut是发言才算签到 一个个人pre一个小组pre一篇500字reflective essay 给龟是玄幻但还行的 wl是极小的 总而言之冲
reviews.translated_content: Got a B+ for some reason... I was aiming for an A-range grade. I don’t really know the grading criteria, but honestly, it’s not bad. There’s almost no workload, and the course has a very low profile. You don’t need to attend lectures; just have someone sign in for you. For tutorials, you only get attendance credit if you speak up. Assessments include one individual presentation, one group presentation, and a 500-word reflective essay. The grading is unpredictable but okay, and the workload is extremely light. All in all, go for it.

reviews.content:
这门课完全对不起学费也对不起我的时间 什么东西都学不到给分还巨烂无比 教授和tutor对得起自己的工资吗？每天这么水课 tutorial每次都是听pre tutor什么也不讲 也不评价 最后问一句有没有人有想法然后听完就走了？tutor存在的意义是什么？
完全难以理解世界上有这么恶心的一门课 水课就算了给分也巨差无比
如果有人选了这门课请把这个评价粘贴到sftl教评里 去年sftl没给这门课写差评是我最后悔的事情 完全可以取消这门课退位让贤吧德不配位的烂课不负责任的tutor和消失的教授
reviews.translated_content: This course is completely unworthy of the tuition fees and my time. You don’t learn anything, and the grading is absolutely terrible. Do the professor and tutors deserve their salaries? Every tutorial is just listening to presentations; the tutor says nothing, gives no feedback, and just asks if anyone has ideas before leaving. What is the point of the tutor’s existence? It’s hard to comprehend how such a disgusting course can exist. It’s a lightweight course, yet the grading is horrendous. If you have taken this course, please paste this review into the Student Feedback on Teaching and Learning (SFTL). Not leaving a negative review for this course last year is my biggest regret. This course should be cancelled to make way for better options. It’s a lousy course undeserving of its place, with irresponsible tutors and a missing professor.

reviews.content: 最推荐的cc！wl超级小，只要写一篇500字的reflective essay，一个individual pre和group pre。没有midterm，没有final，lecture可以不去。最后给分也不错！是一门付出很少但回报率很高的课！推荐推荐～
reviews.translated_content: The most recommended Common Core course! The workload is super small: just one 500-word reflective essay, one individual presentation, and one group presentation. No midterm, no final, and you don't even have to attend lectures. The grading is also quite good! It’s a course that requires very little effort but offers a high return. Highly recommended!

reviews.translated_content: The workload isn't heavy, but there are pop quizzes during class that must be answered within 15 minutes. It's a course with harsh grading.

reviews.content: 好水的课，上课很恐怖但是完全不用听. quiz每节课都有但是是两道开卷的选择题，可以和朋友交流，一小时的时间做，这个quiz说是quiz但是这样子也不打算quiz吧.  听起来医学的课实际上是医德的课，天天教要对病人有同理心之类的. 还有一些很刺激的伦理选择题.
reviews.translated_content: Such a lightweight course. The lectures are terrifying, but you don’t need to listen at all. There are quizzes every class, but they consist of two open-book multiple-choice questions, you can discuss with friends, and you have an hour to complete them. They call it a quiz, but with such conditions, it’s hardly a quiz. Although it sounds like a medical course, it’s actually about medical ethics, constantly teaching empathy towards patients, etc. There are also some quite stimulating ethical multiple-choice questions.

reviews.content: wl超少 tutor老師很好 水了兩節tutor說喉嚨不舒服早放 essay 800字 griup project考carry 最後B+仁慈
reviews.translated_content: The workload is extremely low, and the tutor teacher is very nice. I coasted through two tutorial sessions where the tutor said their throat was uncomfortable and let us leave early. The essay was 800 words. For the group project, I carried the team. I ended up with a B+, which was lenient.

reviews.content: 挺好的，给分不错，tutor人也挺好，当cc还是不错的
reviews.translated_content: It is quite good. The grading is favourable, and the tutor is nice. It is a decent Common Core course.

reviews.content: 没啥workload，没啥干货，龟不太好
reviews.translated_content: Very little workload, very little substantive content, and the grading is not good.

reviews.content: 医学生选的cc 上课没有attendance wl也还好
reviews.translated_content: A Common Core course chosen by medical students. There is no attendance requirement, and the workload is manageable.

reviews.content: wl比較少，有心有創意有努力就攞到A range。上課要用attendance app點名，上完堂之後會有個小online quiz兩條MC，上完堂先會發放lecture note。會邀請唔同嘅醫學院老師教基因相關議題同埋醫德，第一堂邀請罕見病患者過嚟分享，讀呢個course好多都係醫學院。group project係剪一條短片，個人project係3分鐘演講 ，兩個project嘅topic創新有趣就得 自由度好大。上堂嘅嘢係難明啲嘅，不過唔聽都做到功課。
reviews.translated_content: The workload is relatively light. If you are attentive, creative, and hardworking, you can get an A-range grade. Attendance is taken using an app in class. After each class, there is a short online quiz with two multiple-choice questions. Lecture notes are released only after class. Teachers from the Faculty of Medicine are invited to teach gene-related topics and medical ethics. The first class invited patients with rare diseases to share their experiences. Many students taking this course are from the Faculty of Medicine. The group project is editing a short video, and the individual project is a 3-minute speech. As long as the topics for both projects are innovative and interesting, it’s fine; there is a lot of freedom. The content taught in class is a bit difficult to understand, but you can do the assignments even if you don’t listen.

reviews.content: 靓龟。一个video，一个三分钟个人短讲，还有一个因为reading week的电影观后感。每堂课两道ppt上有答案的mc，take attendance。workload不大，也不看tutorial发言。内容不bio，基本上是关于生物的道德伦理和最新生物科技之类的，有DNA检验、如何对待患有稀有疾病的病人等。
reviews.translated_content: Generous grading. There’s one video, one three-minute individual short talk, and a movie reflection due because of Reading Week. Each class has two multiple-choice questions with answers on the slides, and attendance is taken. The workload isn’t heavy, and tutorial participation isn’t graded. The content isn’t heavily biological; it’s mostly about bioethics and the latest biotech, such as DNA testing and how to treat patients with rare diseases.

course_info.title: Artificial Intelligence: Utopia or Dystopia

reviews.content: 还不错，讲AI，其实就是简介，内容包括AI的历史啊种类啊之类的，有点无聊。tutorial会多一点要大家讨论的东西。wl不大，主要是要组队想一个AI产品，写proposal，做present，最后有抽签决定debate/essay的topic，二选一。由于我上的时候是网课，pre改成做视频。主要是要和教授混脸熟，上课多发言，问问题，导致教授在电梯间直接认出了我，谈笑风生。最后拿了A+
reviews.translated_content: It's not bad. It covers AI, but it's really just an introduction, including the history and types of AI, which is a bit boring. Tutorials involve more group discussion. The workload isn't heavy. The main tasks are to team up to conceive an AI product, write a proposal, and do a presentation. Finally, there is a lottery to decide the topic for either a debate or an essay (choose one). Since I took it as an online course, the presentation was changed to making a video. The key is to get on the professor's good side by speaking up and asking questions in class, to the point that the professor recognised me directly in the elevator and we had a friendly chat. I ended up with an A+.

reviews.content: 看网上说好龟才选的 没想到是几门课里面最烂龟的
reviews.translated_content: I chose it because online reviews said it was easy to get a good grade. Unexpectedly, it had the harshest grading among several courses I took.

reviews.content: Run, 这门课这个sem开始烂龟了，小组作业和essay个人都认为做的很好，甚至小组的prototype做的可以说是全场最佳，最后喜提B，本学期最烂的一门课
reviews.translated_content: Run. Starting this semester, the grading for this course has become harsh. My group mates and I felt we did very well on the group assignment and essay; our group’s prototype was arguably the best in the class, yet I ended up with a B. This was the worst course I took this semester.

reviews.content: 很不好的课。听说很好🐢但是就这个最完蛋。GP完全不懂是什么评分标准，individual更是找老师问，说没问题，最后美美拿下C+。令人心碎的课，狗才学。
reviews.translated_content: A very bad course. I heard the grading was generous, but this one was the worst. I had no idea what the grading criteria were for the group project. For the individual component, I even asked the instructor, who said there was no problem, yet I ended up with a C+. A heartbreaking course; only an idiot would take it.

reviews.content: 主要和仿生有关，内容很有意思，讲了很多有趣的动植物和别的生物。但每节tutorial都要现场准备并作演讲（不计分），poster、prez和3篇essay都得创新而且不能重样。如果对开脑洞有信心，还算是不错的课。
reviews.translated_content: Mainly about biomimicry; the content is interesting, covering many fascinating animals, plants, and other organisms. But every tutorial requires on-the-spot preparation and a speech (not graded), and the poster, presentation, and three essays all require innovation and cannot repeat themes. If you’re confident in your creativity, it’s a decent course.

reviews.content: 似乎是去年新开的课，总共才招到40个学生，local含量大，平时上课和tutorial都很有意思，tuto感觉在上神奇动物在哪里，期末写三篇essay，两个gp，wl整体不大，给分不错，可惜本ddl fighter最后水了一篇有点拉分，文科生可冲，gp抱到大佬大腿很重要
reviews.translated_content: It seems to be a new course launched last year, with only 40 students enrolled. There’s a high proportion of local Hong Kong students. The lectures and tutorials are interesting; the tutorials feel like watching Fantastic Beasts. The final assessment consists of three essays and two group projects. The overall workload isn’t heavy, and grading is good. Unfortunately, as someone who struggles with deadlines, I rushed one essay, which dragged my grade down. Humanities students should go for it, and it’s important to team up with very strong students for the group projects.

reviews.content: 课程本身很有趣，但是对创新和逻辑严谨性要求较高。wl适中，所有的lecturers和tutor都非常非常nice！！！喜欢生物学也善于发明创新的同学进，很香！认真创新，设计的项目可行性强即好🐢！
reviews.translated_content: The course itself is interesting, but it demands high levels of innovation and logical rigor. The workload is moderate, and all lecturers and tutors are very, very nice!!! Students who like biology and are good at inventive innovation should join—it’s great! If you innovate seriously and design a feasible project, you’ll get a good grade!

reviews.content: 无敌大烂grade课!!!每星期都要tut都不知道在学什么，跑
reviews.translated_content: A terrible course with poor grading!!! We had tutorials every week but I had no idea what we were learning. Stay away.

reviews.content: 这门课是垃圾中的垃圾，龟烂完了，30%是签到？？？，30%是gp，40%是个人essay。整个学期没出任何成绩，没给任何feedback，期末扔出来一个b-的成绩。无法接受。感觉付出足够多，却被人肆意随便给了一个分数。难以评价，只能说RUN！！！
reviews.translated_content: This course is garbage among garbage. The grading is terrible. Is 30% really based on attendance??? Another 30% is from the group project, and 40% from an individual essay. No grades or feedback were released all semester, and then a B- was thrown out at the end. Unacceptable. I feel I put in enough effort, yet someone arbitrarily assigned me a grade. Hard to comment further—just RUN!!!

reviews.content: 总体来说挺好的，但是给分也不是特别神仙给分，感觉做得非常努力了，还是没有冲到很好的分而且最后小组作业特别特别特别特别特别卷
reviews.translated_content: Overall it’s quite good, but the grading isn’t exceptionally generous. I felt I worked very hard, yet still didn’t manage to get a very high score, and the group project at the end was extremely, extremely competitive.

reviews.content: 真的好龟课 主要是现在还没火起来 快冲 有付出有回报 idea有科学支撑有可执行性就行 对非理科背景不会要求太高的
reviews.translated_content: This is truly a course where good grades are attainable. It has not become overly popular yet, so go for it. Effort yields results; as long as your idea has scientific support and is feasible, it works. The requirements are not too high for students without a science background.

reviews.content: 我上过workload最小grade却最好的课。Tutor Marlene人真的巨好，上课讲话很温柔，用烂英语瞎几把答问题也会得到鼓励的话语，总之就是上得非常非常开心的一门课。Tutorial不需要preparation，lecture有许多个不同的guest来讲课，一点也不沉闷。最后各占40%的group project和individual work加起来花了我不到半天，结果是我CC里最高分的（A）总之就是非常值得上的好龟课！
reviews.translated_content: This is the course I've taken with the smallest workload and the best grade. Tutor Marlene is genuinely wonderful; she speaks very gently in class, and even if you answer questions in broken English nonsense, you get encouraging words. In short, it was a very, very happy course. Tutorials require no preparation; lectures have many different guest speakers, so it's not boring at all. The group project and individual work, each worth 40%, took me less than half a day in total, and the result was my highest score in Common Core (A). In short, it's a very worthwhile, GPA-friendly course!

workload非常小，就是平时的tutorial，一个GP video，一个individual work，但是！没有说的那么好龟的感觉，我individual做的poster最后是B（很伤心，因为tutorial一次没缺，poster也有认真做内容，GP做的自我感觉很好因为真的和组员一起努力了但最后这门课最低淦）

reviews.content: 无任何理科背景的社科同学强推这门st课，神仙lecturer神仙tutor外加无wl无压力你值得拥有。  lecturer& tutor: prof和tutor都是内地人，人非常好，Ouyang上课虽然不那么有趣但是人真的很好，nicole简直就是本tutorial厌恶者的救星，tutorial从不强迫同学发言和回答问题，也不算分数，非常轻松，整个学期无压力度过。  Assessment: 主要就是三个midterm assignment都是为了final paper作准备的小练习，例如什么分析理科论文还有什么定一个合理的研究题目之类的。然后个人觉得比较重要的就是artwork creation外加1000字对这个作品的简介，然后从这个artwork当中找一个适合的题目进行研究，写一篇2000字的research paper。因为是社科人，中学也几乎没读过理科，所以一点基础都没有，只是尝试去找论文去读，定了一个相对来说有研究价值的题目，然后就开始努力肝理科论文，最好的地方在于这门课说了不那么在意研究的深度和细节什么的，而是看有没有掌握研究脑神经科学的一些基本知识，所以对文科人也很友好。  最后得分是A+，对于社科人来说真的很惊喜的，所以也想推荐给大家!!!这是一门对文科生非常友好的ccst!!!
reviews.translated_content: I strongly recommend this ST course to social-science students with no science background. You get a god-tier lecturer and tutor, plus no workload and no pressure—you deserve it. Lecturer & tutor: Both the professor and the tutor are from mainland China and are very nice people. Although Ouyang’s lectures aren’t that interesting, he is genuinely kind. Nicole is a saviour for those who hate tutorials; she never forces students to speak or answer questions, doesn’t grade participation, and is very relaxed. I went through the whole semester stress-free. Assessment: It mainly consists of three midterm assignments that serve as small exercises to prepare for the final paper, such as analysing a scientific paper or defining a reasonable research topic. Personally, I think the more important parts are the artwork creation plus a 1,000-word introduction to the work, and then choosing a suitable topic based on that artwork to write a 2,000-word research paper. As a social-science student who hardly studied science in secondary school, I had zero foundation. I just tried to find papers to read, picked a topic with relatively high research value, and then worked hard on reading scientific papers. The best part is that this course doesn’t care much about the depth or details of the research, but rather whether you have mastered some basic knowledge of neuroscience, so it is also friendly to humanities students. My final grade was A+, which was a real surprise for a social-science student, so I want to recommend it to everyone!!! This is a CCST course that is very friendly to humanities students!!!

reviews.content: 虽然是st下的内容，但内容侧重emotion和cognition一点，是偏文科的课。课的话题还是挺有趣的，比如game/arts/animals/AI and emotion, 但就是讲的比较浅，课堂略显无聊；wl很小，每人1000 group project summary + 2000 research paper, 作为非理院学生get到如何写如此理院风的paper也算是个小收获，并且大量research过程中能学到挺多topic相关知识的。个人觉得给分很好，paper能写的好的朋友们不需要太担心。lecturer和tutor人都很好。
reviews.translated_content: Although it is an ST-track course, the content leans more towards emotion and cognition, so it is quite humanities-oriented. The topics are quite interesting, such as games, arts, animals, and AI and emotion, but the teaching is rather shallow and the classes are slightly boring. The workload is light: a 1,000-word group project summary and a 2,000-word research paper. As a non-Science student, learning how to write such a Science-style paper was a small takeaway, and I learned quite a bit of topic-related knowledge during the extensive research process. Personally, I think the grading is generous; friends who can write good papers don’t need to worry too much. Both the lecturer and tutor are very nice.

reviews.content: 一门没有quiz的cc课，emotion,cognition and brain，组成是三次作业，一次比一次离谱，第一次作业提四个问题（这个还行），第二次作业是做一段能trigger emotion的音视频/画，还要写几百字报告，第三次作业我无语，加起来3000+字essay，合着比我那个ccgl写得还多，理院人震怒 还有就是上课有点无聊...可能是我太菜了学不明白，不过tutor小姐姐很棒！
reviews.translated_content: A Common Core course with no quizzes. It covers emotion, cognition, and brain. The assessment consists of three assignments, each more ridiculous than the last. The first assignment asks four questions (this one was okay). The second requires creating an audio/video clip or image that triggers emotion, plus writing a report of a few hundred words. The third assignment left me speechless: a 3000+ word essay, which ended up being longer than my CCGL essay. As a Science student, I was furious. Also, the lectures are a bit boring... maybe I’m just not strong enough in the subject to understand it. But the female tutor was great!

reviews.content: 不要被迷惑了！这节课没有任何实质性的知识 wl非常小（没有wl 最后选了Pass
reviews.translated_content: Don't be misled! This course has no substantive knowledge. The workload is very small (there was no workload; I ultimately chose Pass).

reviews.content: 实在是无语......别选 本人没有选择组队 但是真的很认真对待essay了 各种作业都努力做好了 然后C range。。。真的不推荐
reviews.translated_content: I’m seriously speechless... Don’t choose this. I didn’t choose to work in a group, but I really took the essay seriously and worked hard on all the assignments, and then I got a C-range grade... Really not recommended.

reviews.content: 课程：lecturer 符合我对理工男刻板印象哈哈，不是特别擅长把硬核概念讲给毫无理科背景的人，但人很好也很有耐心，不厌其烦地给我们解释。tutor Rebecca 小姐姐我太爱了，极其富有教育热情的老师，尽最大可能让我们快乐地学会课上内容。wl: 对我不算很小，每节课以后都有questions & reflection 要写，感觉要拿好点的分每次总共也会写到500～700字，此外还有project , essay& report. 好处是project不强制组队，但组队会加分。给分：我最后有A+，应该有拉curve, 我问过分的几次reflection都在4.5/5左右，不算特别高，然后project有组队有主动pre都有一定的加分。essay &report 分数未知，个人感觉自己写得水水的。这个好龟我觉得确实挺玄乎，不多评价。
reviews.translated_content: Course: The lecturer fits my stereotype of a STEM guy, haha. He isn’t particularly skilled at explaining rigorous concepts to people with no science background, but he is very nice and patient, tirelessly explaining things to us. I absolutely love the tutor, Rebecca—a teacher with immense passion for education who does her best to help us happily learn the course content. Workload: Not exactly light for me. After every class, there are questions and reflections to write; to get a decent mark, I’d write about 500–700 words each time. There is also a project, an essay, and a report. The upside is that the project doesn’t require group work, but working in a group earns extra marks. Grading: I ended up with an A+. There was probably a grading curve. My scores for the several reflections I asked about were around 4.5/5, which isn’t particularly high, but having a group and actively presenting in the project gave some extra marks. I don’t know the marks for the essay and report; personally, I feel I wrote them in a lightweight manner. This course’s generous grading does seem quite mysterious, so I won’t comment further.

reviews.content: 才开的一门新课，人特别少，最后因为香港的问题项目都online了
reviews.translated_content: It’s a newly launched course with very few students. In the end, due to the situation in Hong Kong, the projects went online.

reviews.translated_content: All the instructors are from mainland China.

reviews.content: 课比较无聊 没有wl
reviews.translated_content: The lectures are rather boring. There is no workload.

reviews.content: assessment偏学术

reviews.content: wl超小，课也挺有趣的（不想听可以不听），第一次见到没有tut pre没有quiz的cc，tutorial一般都是小组讨论project和recap课上的内容。Tutor Annie人特别温柔，说几句话就有bonus！
reviews.translated_content: The workload is very small, and the class is quite interesting (you can skip if you don’t want to listen). It’s the first Common Core course I’ve seen with no tutorial presentations or quizzes. Tutorials usually involve group discussions on the project and recapping lecture content. Tutor Annie is extremely gentle; just saying a few words earns bonus points!

reviews.content: 好龟，基本上啥也么干上台录了段rap就A了，好玩
reviews.translated_content: Generous grading. I basically did nothing, went on stage to record a rap, and got an A. Fun.

reviews.content: 帅哥美女最多的课，认识一帮特别好的朋友，wl小，local很多，基本没有内地生
reviews.translated_content: The class with the most handsome guys and beautiful girls. I made a great group of friends. The workload is light, there are many local Hong Kong students, and basically no students from Mainland China.

reviews.content: 整体wl不大，最后的gp很有意思，大家基本上都是做的视频，学期中也有监督自己运动的assessment，很好的cc
reviews.translated_content: Overall, the workload isn't heavy. The final group project is quite interesting; most people made videos. There are also assessments during the semester to monitor your own exercise. It's a great Common Core course.

reviews.content: 没什么wl,但为啥lecture attendance记那么严
reviews.translated_content: Not much workload, but why is lecture attendance recorded so strictly?

reviews.content: 800words and 500words + presentation. 超小wl！ 🐢靚！
reviews.translated_content: 800 words and 500 words + presentation. Super low workload! Good grade!

reviews.content: wl蛮小的：期中一篇800自己监督运动的reflection ➕ 300字field trip observation ➕随机分组gp 说实话除了attendance要求严格以外其他都很轻松，pre很多人就是播放提前录制好的视频。gp反正我的组很多contribute的很少，但主要题目很简单，自己做完也不花时间。
reviews.translated_content: The workload is quite light: a mid-term 800-word reflection on self-supervised exercise + a 300-word field trip observation + a randomly grouped group project. Honestly, apart from strict attendance requirements, everything else is very relaxed. For the presentation, many people just played pre-recorded videos. As for the group project, many members in my group contributed little, but since the main topic was simple, doing it myself didn’t take much time.

reviews.content: 两篇Essay（一长一短）一个GP（视频+report），对擅长写essay的人挺友好的，而且题目非常简单，稍微认真就能拿到不错的成绩。但是GP是随机分组，遇到什么样的组友全看造化，GP的workload也不算很小。tutor很nice，老师也都很好说话，会在出龟很久之前就提供每个小项的分数。我本来以为自己是B+（单项核算之后不到85），但是最后A-，算是意外的小惊喜了
reviews.translated_content: There are two essays (one long, one short) and a group project (video + report). It’s quite friendly for those good at writing essays, and the topics are very simple; you can get a decent grade with just a bit of effort. However, the group project involves random grouping, so your teammates depend entirely on luck, and the workload for the group project isn’t exactly small. The tutor is very nice, and the professors are approachable; they provide the scores for each component long before the final grades are released. I originally thought I would get a B+ (my calculated total was under 85), but I ended up with an A-, which was a pleasant surprise.

reviews.content: lightwork好🐢课，课改后一学期剩返一篇reading week后300字之report，与midterm前后ddl的800字对自己6星期生理指标tracking的analysis，最后就是一个非传统形式的gp presentation；lectureattendance是QR code➕可做到区分度的课堂参与bonus points，如lecture举手答题可额外加分
reviews.translated_content: Light workload, GPA-friendly course. After the course revision, there’s only one 300-word report after Reading Week, an 800-word analysis of your six-week physiological tracking with deadlines around the midterm, and finally a non-traditional group project presentation. Lecture attendance is tracked via QR code, plus there are participation bonus points that differentiate students; for example, raising your hand to answer questions in lectures earns extra points.

reviews.content: wl不算大，GP比较重要，队友是随机分的，local居多，tutorial要积极参与发言，🐢还不错
reviews.translated_content: The workload is not heavy. The group project is relatively important. Teammates are assigned randomly, mostly local students. You need to participate actively in tutorials. The grading is quite good.

reviews.content: La physique quantique est absolument fascinante et le cours est tout à fait faisable même si on n'y connait rien. Il n'y a pas de maths. La prof de tutoriel indienne était médiocre (pour ne pas dire raciste), elle appelait les gens par leurs vêtements parce qu'elle n'apprenait toujours pas les noms après un semestre. Je me suis beaucoup investi pour le rendu final (qui aurait honnêtement mérité un A+) mais la tortue🐢 n'était pas à la hauteur de mes espérances :(
reviews.translated_content: Quantum physics is absolutely fascinating, and the course is quite manageable even if you know nothing about it. There is no maths. The Indian tutorial instructor was mediocre (not to say racist); she called people by their clothes because she still hadn’t learned their names after a semester. I invested a lot in the final submission (which honestly deserved an A+), but the grading did not meet my expectations :(

reviews.content: b range course, 0 wl.
reviews.translated_content: A B-range course, zero workload.

reviews.content: 接近0的wl！冲就完事了！只有两个10%的quiz（15min 左右），一个30% midterm essay（2 page）一个50% final project（可单飞可gp）内容随意发挥！只有tutorial attendance不太友好hhh
reviews.translated_content: Close to zero workload! Just go for it! reviews.content: wl真的不大，两次test简单记一下ppt就可以，还可以上手量子计算机 期中一个writeup期末一个项目，可单人可小组，感觉不错
reviews.translated_content: The workload is really not heavy. For the two tests, you just need to memorise the PowerPoint slides. You even get hands-on experience with a quantum computer. There’s one write-up for the midterm and one project for the final, which can be done individually or in a group. It feels pretty good.

reviews.content: 团队挺好，一门合格的科普量子信息类的课。workload中上，有2quiz，1midterm，1pre，final project。final组队比较重要。🐢还行
reviews.translated_content: The team is quite good; it’s a decent introductory course on quantum information. The workload is medium-high, with 2 quizzes, 1 midterm, 1 presentation, and a final project. Forming a good team for the final is relatively important. The grading is okay.

reviews.content: extremely small workload. but there is a group project for the finals. got A range.

reviews.content: small workload, but requires to understand the knowledge well.The grade is not as good as expected.

reviews.content: 冲着好龟wl小选的cc，本身对这方面知识没有太大兴趣，但最后拿了b+也不觉得轻松，体验不怎么样的一门课。课程内容主要是关于量子理论以及一系列应用，讲的比较浅更多的是概念性的知识不涉及更深的理论。wl大概是两个quiz➕一个较短的essay➕一个final project，tutorial记attendance。关于wl，我不觉得很小，因为quiz有闭卷的所以要背很多知识，final project自由度很大反而不知道该做什么，最后莫名其妙拿了个75我只能自认倒霉。tutorial体验也不怎么样，tutor也是抓来代课的phd，自己好像也不怎么了解就硬带着大家提问讨论，挺无聊的也完全不helpful，蛮草台班子的。总之我在这门课遇到的很多人事都不怎么样，有一些personal的原因但总之体验不好，因人而异吧
reviews.translated_content: I chose this Common Core course because it promised generous grading and a small workload. I wasn’t very interested in the subject matter, and although I ended up with a B+, it didn’t feel easy; it was a poor experience overall. The course content mainly covers quantum theory and a series of applications, taught rather superficially with more conceptual knowledge and no deeper theory. The workload consists of two quizzes, one shorter essay, and one final project, with attendance taken in tutorials. Regarding the workload, I don’t think it’s small, because the quizzes are closed-book so you have to memorise a lot. The final project has a lot of freedom, making it hard to know what to do; I inexplicably got a 75 in the end, which I can only attribute to bad luck. The tutorial experience wasn’t great either; the tutor was a PhD student drafted in to substitute, who didn’t seem to understand the material well and just forced everyone to ask questions and discuss. It was boring and completely unhelpful—quite amateurish. In short, many of the people I encountered in this course were not great. There were some personal reasons, but overall the experience was bad. It varies by person.

reviews.translated_content: An absolute legend. As an Arts student with zero physics background and poor English, I still got an A. It’s an extremely GPA-friendly course.

reviews.content: wl不大，lec可以完全不听。两个gp不太难，essay不到1k字。这是一门communication intensive的课，社恐人别来。因为是医学cc，有很多不看gpa的医学生来选，所以他们gp就不会很认真，建议和认识的靠谱队友组队来（4人）。每项都是median，最后b+。不算很烂但也不是很好龟。
reviews.translated_content: The workload isn’t heavy, and you can completely skip the lectures. The two group projects aren’t too difficult, and the essay is under 1,000 words. This is a communication-intensive course, so if you’re very uncomfortable with social participation, don’t take it. Because it’s a Medical Common Core course, many medical students who don’t care about GPA enrol, so they don’t take the group projects very seriously. I recommend forming a team with reliable people you know (4 members). My scores were around the median for each component, and I finished with a B+. It’s not terrible, but it’s not exactly easy to get a good grade either.

reviews.content:
wl一般 lecture就是给你科普的 不考
700-1k字essay 还可以 给分OK
听说好🐢才选的 结果出分才B。。。 主要问题出现在组员上，因为很多医学生，他们不care GPA，会缺席开会 不认真做gpre 不认真讨论project 给一些很烂的idea。建议朋友多一起选 比较容易拿好一点的分数
吐槽一下project给分 给教授看的时候说perfectly ok。结果出来不到median 真的无语
reviews.translated_content: The workload is average. Lectures are just for general knowledge and are not examined. The 700–1k word essay is okay, and the grading is acceptable. I heard the grading was generous, so I chose it, but I only got a B... The main problem was with the group members. Because there were many medical students, they didn’t care about GPA: they missed meetings, didn’t take the group presentation seriously, didn’t discuss the project properly, and provided some terrible ideas. I suggest taking this course with friends; it’s easier to get a better grade that way. One complaint about the project grading: when we showed it to the professor, he said it was 'perfectly ok'. But the result was below the median. Seriously...

reviews.content: 非常烂龟，明明整个小组都很认真在做了，还是是B range。成绩和花了多少努力不成正比。避雷！！！！下面那个全组A的是一个fintech的人。
reviews.translated_content: The grading was terrible. Even though our whole group worked very hard, we still got a B-range grade. The results were not proportional to the effort spent. Avoid this course!!!! The person below who said their whole group got As is from Fintech.

reviews.content: 最好和Fintech专业的大佬朋友组队，这学期两个记分作业，一个是individual的essay（关于CBDC），另一个是小组作业，做一个decision tree。最后还有一个group presentation。最后A+，感觉队友给力挺重要的。
reviews.translated_content: It’s best to team up with strong friends from the Fintech major. This semester had two graded assignments: an individual essay on CBDC and a group assignment to create a decision tree. There was also a final group presentation. Final grade: A+. I feel having capable teammates is quite important.

reviews.content: 我一个零基础的竟然听懂了，主要讲的是区块链，比特币和数字经济，内容丰富但不那么深，作业也都是写定性分析。PS我跟上条评论是一个组的。
reviews.translated_content: As a complete beginner, I actually understood it. It mainly covers blockchain, Bitcoin, and the digital economy. The content is rich but not too deep, and the assignments involve qualitative analysis. P.S. I was in the same group as the previous reviewer.

reviews.content: 讲的都是比较基础的Fintech内容，讲的很浅很安心，课挺水的，ta人很好，最后拿A
reviews.translated_content: The content covers relatively basic Fintech topics. It's taught in a shallow, reassuring way. The course is quite lightweight. The TA is very nice. I ended up with an A.

reviews.content: 有点水，最开始讲了一个blockchain的原理后全都是定性的东西，和grade也都没啥关系，没什么兴致好好听。wl适中，有一个gp一个essay一个小quiz每节tut三个人一组现场准备一个5分钟的pre. 🐢还行，但是全程不公布小分很讨厌，要冲极致高分的不建议选，否则一般不会很差。
reviews.translated_content: It's a bit lightweight. After introducing the principles of blockchain at the start, the rest is all qualitative content that doesn't really relate to the grade, so I didn't have much interest in listening carefully. The workload is moderate. There is one group project, one essay, and a small quiz. In every tutorial, groups of three have to prepare a 5-minute presentation on the spot. The grading is okay, but it's annoying that component marks are never released. If you're aiming for an extremely high score, I wouldn't recommend it; otherwise, your grade generally won't be bad.

reviews.content: 比较水，wl确实小，平常基本没什么事情，期中期末稍微紧一下就行。组队很重要，一定要找好队友才行，抱了大腿最后A-了
reviews.translated_content: It’s quite lightweight; the workload is indeed small. There’s basically nothing to do usually; you just need to tighten up a bit for the midterms and finals. Team formation is important; you must find good teammates. I rode on someone’s coattails and got an A- in the end.

reviews.content: 大水课，不推荐，因为组的队大家都不会fintech，全程diy，lecture上了前几节，感觉对final report完全没有，wl适中，全程不公布小分，也不知道哪里低分了，最后B
reviews.translated_content: A lightweight course. Not recommended. Since no one in my group knew fintech, we had to DIY everything. I only attended the first few lectures, which felt completely irrelevant to the final report. The workload was moderate. Small marks were never disclosed throughout the semester, so I don’t know where I lost points. Ended up with a B.

reviews.content: lecture没去，tutorial翘了一半，essay一般，group project吵架，最后还能A完全出乎我的意料。感觉压力最大的是tutorial，每周都是当场给题目限时10分钟左右要research+present。因为时间有限 大家都用ai内容同质化 加上对题目背景也不了解，如果没有大佬carry 或者presentation skills很强的话很容易低分（查分的时候瞄了眼，全世界都在6分上下 有个别subclass某几周甚至只有4-5）。虽然tutorial占比不高但还是建议主动追问feedback，因为对final present会很有帮助
reviews.translated_content: I didn’t attend lectures and skipped half of the tutorials. My essay was average, and there was arguing in the group project. Getting an A in the end was completely unexpected. I felt the most pressure came from the tutorials: every week, we were given a topic on the spot and had about 10 minutes to research and present. Due to the time limit, everyone used AI, leading to homogeneous content, and many didn’t understand the background of the topic. If you don’t have a very strong student carrying the group or strong presentation skills, it’s easy to get a low score. When checking grades, I glanced around and saw that most people were scoring around 6, with some sections even getting only 4–5 in certain weeks. Although tutorials don’t carry a high weight, I suggest actively seeking feedback, as it will be very helpful for the final presentation.

reviews.content: 避雷！每次tutorial都需要根据临时问题做group presentation！给分不好。
reviews.translated_content: Avoid this course! Every tutorial requires you to do a group presentation based on impromptu questions! The grading is poor.

reviews.content: The professor and lectures are okay, but assignment/tutors are pure bs. Tutorials are mainly group presentations, but with inconsistent grading with everyone receiving the same grade. Not worth the effort for the grade.
reviews.translated_content: The professor and lectures are okay, but assignment/tutors are pure bs. Tutorials are mainly group presentations, but with inconsistent grading with everyone receiving the same grade. Not worth the effort for the grade.

reviews.content: 。过来人说句真心话了，能赶紧跑就赶紧跑。别选！！！！！！！wl大的一批，比专业课还大。一篇長essay加一篇長報告，加三四篇日記（告诉他你学到了什么。）还有一份小组作业，繁琐的一批。Prof纯纯一笑面虎，cc真没必要选这么一门课来折磨自己的身心。作业都完成的不错，有80左右，最后竟然给了个C？给爷气笑了。。gp 占比很大，组队也要凭运气，运气差就等着烂🐢吧。真心怀疑当初这个prof是为了吸引更多人报这门课，所以一开始给分比较友好。。。。。
reviews.translated_content: Let me give you some honest advice from experience: run away as soon as you can. Do not choose this course!!!!! The workload is massive, even heavier than major courses. There is one long essay, one long report, three or four journals (telling him what you learned), and a group assignment—it’s extremely tedious. The professor is purely all smiles but ruthless. There’s really no need to torture your mind and body with this Common Core course. I completed all assignments well, scoring around 80, but he actually gave me a C? It made me laugh out of anger. The group project carries significant weight, and teaming up depends on luck; if you’re unlucky, just wait for harsh grading. I genuinely suspect that initially, this professor gave generous grades to attract more students to enroll in this course.....

reviews.content: 老师人巨好，特别关心学生，但是wl大，reflection，report，essay什么一堆，最后给分不太好（gp蛮重要的）
reviews.translated_content: The instructor is extremely nice and cares deeply about students, but the workload is heavy, with a pile of reflections, reports, essays, and so on. The final grades aren’t very good (the group project carries significant weight).

reviews.content: 老师确实很supportive，人很温柔，但是最后得分被背刺了。课程内容比较多，workload不小，还要去实验室做实验写报告，确实不好写。平时上课没有什么内容，还是可以选的一门课，但确实不知道为什么最后得分很不理想。
reviews.translated_content: The instructor is indeed very supportive and gentle, but I was backstabbed by my final score. The course content is quite extensive, the workload is not small, and you have to go to the lab to conduct experiments and write reports, which are indeed difficult to write. There isn’t much content in regular classes. It’s still a course you can choose, but I really don’t know why my final score was so unsatisfactory.

reviews.content: 超级无敌好的一门cc，教授人非常非常nice，关心学生的心理健康甚至说如果感到难过可以随时email我，他会"make myself available for you"，当时听到就很感动，而且他不仅仅是说说而已，ins上还经常给我点赞hhh，课程安排也很有意思，学期中旬tutorial是bone lab，去医院研究人类遗骨，是能学到很多硬核知识的，印象深刻的那种。给grade也很好，最后是a，非常满意啦~
reviews.translated_content: This is an absolutely excellent Common Core course. The professor is very, very nice and cares about students’ mental health, even saying that if you feel down, you can email him anytime as he will “make myself available for you.” I was really touched when I heard that, and he doesn’t just say it—he often likes my posts on Instagram, haha. The course schedule is also interesting; the tutorial in the middle of the semester was at the bone lab, studying human remains at a hospital, where you can learn a lot of rigorous knowledge that leaves a deep impression. The grading is also generous; I finally got an A, very satisfied~

reviews.content: 傻逼课程狗都不读，笑面虎教授，表面一套背地一套Essay接近90 reflective essay 都100，gp free ride，教授TA从不回邮件，最后给分一坨大便
reviews.translated_content: This is a shitty course; even dogs wouldn’t take it. The professor is all smiles but ruthless—friendly on the surface but harsh behind the scenes. My essay was nearly 90, and the reflective essay was 100, making the group project a free ride. However, the professor and TA never replied to emails, and the final grade was a pile of crap.

reviews.content: 跑。wl巨大 比专业课大真不开玩笑，前面的长essay可以二选一但是占比一般，中途要给周围人分享人类学知识然后写你的感受和收获，最后public engagement占比特别大又是写小组计划又是pre又是最后做视频/海报/线下活动之类的事情。。。做了一堆事花了特别多时间然后出分被气晕
reviews.translated_content: Run away. The workload is huge—seriously larger than that of major courses, no joke. You can choose one of two long essays at the beginning, but they carry average weight. In the middle, you have to share anthropological knowledge with people around you and write about your feelings and takeaways. Finally, public engagement accounts for a very large proportion, involving writing a group plan, giving a presentation, and finally producing a video/poster/offline activity, among other things... I did a heap of things and spent a lot of time, only to be infuriated by the grade.

reviews.content: 老师人特别特别好，但是wl真很大要写很多report和essay啥的（基本都要2k➕）。tuto中期会变成2个小时的lab课。gp找了一个很牛的组长，最后拿了A。感觉是必须找好gpmate并且自己也对这门课有兴趣才能拿高分的一门课。。
reviews.translated_content: The teacher is exceptionally nice, but the workload is truly heavy. You have to write many reports and essays (mostly over 2k words). Mid-term tutorials turn into two-hour lab sessions. I found a very capable group leader for the group project and ended up with an A. I feel this is a course where you must find good group mates and have personal interest in the subject to get a high score.

reviews.content: Prof人绝好！wl虽然大但是课程设置超级有意思，给🐢也好
reviews.translated_content: The professor is absolutely wonderful! Although the workload is heavy, the course structure is super interesting, and the grading is generous.

reviews.content: 讲真心话，这位教授有点变态。。。
reviews.translated_content: To be honest, this professor is a bit brutal...

reviews.content: 跑，赶紧跑。wl特别大，现在给分也一搬了，课程有一定难度的，gp也很复杂碰上free rider直接完蛋。
reviews.translated_content: Run, get out while you can. The workload is huge, grading has become mediocre, and the course is quite difficult. The group project is also complex; if you encounter a free rider, you’re done for.

reviews.content: 千万别选这门课…….真的很恶心的workload，比专业课的workload还多。我只能说今年换tutor了，不建议大家来开盲盒。lecturer很好，但是主要是tutor，作业真的巨巨巨巨巨多很不合理。首先要做python作业，然后写analysis，每周都有。这是每周fixed量的作业，在此基础上要准备两场quiz，一份小组作业，一份individual essay。essay要写1500-2000字。小组作业更是…，名义上是一份小组作业，但是分成了n多份！！每周都要交一点，分成了proposed topic，presentation，story map还有peer evaluateion。隐形作业巨多，这个workload真的很不合理，我每个周末都在花大量的时间去做cc课的作业，小组作业更是freerider之类的，这门cc课千万避雷，去年的评价好是因为去年的tutor好，不要来这门课开盲盒。这位印度tutor她真的应该反思一下自己的作业量，极其不合理……我问了好多一起上课的同学，都表示这比专业课作业还多。而且这位tutor给分也很奇葩….属于是一份作业错一点点就给你打B+，明明花了很多时间精力去学，认真写了交上去了，就很奇葩………………千万别选千万别选千万别选选了会难受半年
reviews.translated_content: Do not choose this course under any circumstances... The workload is really disgusting, even heavier than that of major courses. I can only say that the tutor changed this year, so I don’t recommend taking a gamble. The lecturer is good, but the main issue is the tutor. The amount of homework is unreasonably huge. First, there are Python assignments, followed by analysis reports, every single week. This is a fixed weekly workload. On top of that, you have to prepare for two quizzes, one group project, and one individual essay. The essay is 1,500–2,000 words. The group project is even worse... Nominally it’s one group project, but it’s split into countless parts!! You have to submit something every week, divided into proposed topic, presentation, story map, and peer evaluation. There are tons of hidden tasks. This workload is really unreasonable. I spent a lot of time every weekend working on assignments for this Common Core course. The group project also had free riders. Definitely avoid this CC course. Last year’s reviews were good because the tutor was good; don’t come here to take a gamble. This Indian tutor really needs to reflect on her assignment load—it’s extremely unreasonable... I asked many classmates, and they all said there was more homework than in their major courses. Also, this tutor’s grading is very weird... If you make even a small mistake in an assignment, she gives you a B+. You spend a lot of time and effort learning and writing seriously, but the grading is just bizarre... Do not choose this course, do not choose this course, do not choose this course. If you do, you’ll suffer for half a year.

reviews.content:
快跑。一向不喜欢骂人也不喜欢在出🐢之前下定论但这次真的忍不住了。先说教授，第一个教授口音很抽象还喜欢放视频一上课就是我们来看视频吧，第二个教授还行，视频变少了内容变多了口音也比较标准（除了比较能扯），tutor今年换了个印度妹，说的话口音重到0人能懂且。再说wl，看了ric的评价是wl小，实际一看adp后前四周每周都有lab report动不动要你对着一张图分析几百个字，report结束之后是gp，gp你首先要定方向找数据库写介绍交第一次作业，之后要用他们自己的网站做一个完整的网页这个网页还会莫名其妙抽风（我们组在pre的前一晚排练的时候发现他自动退回了中间的某一个版本但是没人动过它）之后要把网页交上去再做pre。至于🐢呢，可能是本人确实和地理八字犯冲实力不够，不会分析，反正lab report没见过a打头，没错误b+，犯个错b-，但是听课上周围同学议论好像也有很多都是b+没见过a打头（不过还是听到了少数人有a-的）；gp的🐢不评价因为还没出；quiz的话更是一巴掌又两巴掌又左右开弓，考的知识点一次比一次抽象，第一次喜欢考视频里的内容，又细又容易忽略还难复习得到，第二次也就是今天直接爆改成了记忆力大赛，诸如在总共几百页的PPT里面要你准确的选出一个数字是11，12，13还是14😅（不是真正的这四个数字做选项只是类比举个例子、这样应该不算泄题吧）。烂🐢还有一个原因呢就是根本没人管作弊，在考试途中你可以听到对答案的可以看到gpt的并且这些人是一抓一大把考完试uni大家都说看到了的，那么最后是谁倒霉呢当然是认认真真复习但复习不到点子上（或者复习到了但是打不过科技的力量）的老实人呀🥰🥰
千言万语汇成一个字：run！
reviews.translated_content: Get out while you can. I usually don’t like to complain or pass judgment before grades are released, but this time I really couldn’t hold back. First, the professors: the first professor has a very bizarre accent and loves playing videos—class basically starts with “let’s watch a video.” The second professor is okay; fewer videos, more content, and a more standard accent (though he tends to ramble). This year, the tutor was replaced by an Indian woman whose accent is so heavy that no one can understand her. As for the workload, RIC reviews said it was light, but in reality, during the first four weeks after the add/drop period, there was a lab report every week, often requiring hundreds of words analyzing a single image. After the reports came the group project. For the GP, you first need to define a direction, find a database, write an introduction, and submit the first assignment. Then you have to build a complete webpage using their proprietary website, which glitches inexplicably (our group found that it automatically reverted to an intermediate version the night before our presentation rehearsal, even though no one had touched it). After submitting the webpage, you do the presentation. As for the grades, maybe I’m just incompatible with geography and lack the ability to analyze; anyway, I’ve never seen an A on a lab report. With no errors, it’s a B+; with an error, it’s a B-. But hearing classmates discuss it, it seems many also got B+s and rarely saw A-range grades (though I did hear a few people got A-s). I won’t comment on the GP grade because it hasn’t been released yet. The quizzes were another slap in the face, then another, then left and right hooks. The tested concepts became more and more absurd each time. The first quiz liked to test details from the videos, which were easy to overlook and hard to review. The second quiz, which was today, turned into a memory contest straight-up, such as asking you to accurately pick whether a number in hundreds of pages of PPTs was 11, 12, 13, or 14 😅 (not literally these four numbers as options, just an analogy; hope this doesn’t count as leaking questions). Another reason for the harsh grading is that cheating is completely unmonitored. During the exam, you could hear people comparing answers and see others using GPT, and these people were everywhere. After the exam, everyone at uni said they saw it. So who ends up suffering? Of course, it’s the honest students who reviewed seriously but missed the point (or hit the point but couldn’t beat the power of technology) 🥰🥰. All my words boil down to one: run!

reviews.content: 真真大烂水课！！lecture几乎学不到任何东西，教授不是在放视频就是在胡滋……无语了😓workload巨大无比巨大无比巨大无比而且毫无意义我只能说根本没有什么提升
reviews.translated_content: Truly a terrible, lightweight course!! You learn almost nothing from the lectures; the professor either plays videos or rambles... speechless. 😓 The workload is enormous, enormous, enormous, and completely meaningless. I can only say there was no improvement at all.

reviews.content: lecture要用app签到，内容可以划水，期中和期末的那堂lecture有quiz，都是选择题，像是科学小知识那种但很细，应该是lecture上讲过的？但反正我不会（期末那次不知道是题目出问题了还是怎么，很离谱，几个同学都说看不懂）。每周有tutorial要签到，去lab机房里听tutor讲解（听不懂，口音问题），听后要做4个worksheet，就是要你去Google Earth Engine上操作找数据➕截图➕写report什么的。如果其它课wl不大，还是可以考虑下选这个，组里也有同学确实很感兴趣也学到了很多东西的。但如果其它课需要花的功夫较多，一定要慎重考虑，毕竟每次动辄几大百词还加各种操作的作业确实有点恼火（况且我也没什么兴趣）。哦对了，期末有gp，做arcGIS story map并presentation。还有1500到2000词的individual essay，标准格式。wl确实有点大大，但毕竟不知道其它多数cc情况是否如此，而且这学期上的课wl都挺大的，人已半死，就不太好评价。如果有机会让我在专业课与这个之间选一个，我会选这个。如果几门专业课定死再来问我加不加这个，我会run
reviews.translated_content: Lectures require checking in via an app. You can coast through the content. There are quizzes during the midterm and final lecture sessions, all multiple-choice questions. They’re like trivial science facts but very detailed—probably covered in lectures? But anyway, I didn’t know them (for the final, I don’t know if there was an issue with the questions or what, but it was ridiculous; several classmates said they couldn’t understand them either). Weekly tutorials require check-in; you go to the computer lab to listen to the tutor explain (couldn’t understand due to accent issues). Afterward, you have to complete four worksheets, which involve operating Google Earth Engine to find data, taking screenshots, writing reports, etc. If your other courses don’t have a heavy workload, you might consider taking this. Some classmates in my group were genuinely interested and learned a lot. But if your other courses require significant effort, you must choose with caution, after all, assignments动辄 involving hundreds of words plus various operations are indeed quite annoying (plus I had little interest). Oh, and there’s a group project for the final: creating an ArcGIS story map and giving a presentation. There’s also a 1500–2000 word individual essay in standard format. The workload is indeed somewhat heavy, but since I don’t know if most other CC courses are like this, and the workload for all my courses this semester was heavy (I’m half-dead), it’s hard to judge fairly. If given the choice between a major course and this one, I would choose this. If my major courses were fixed and I was asked whether to add this, I would stay away.

reviews.content:
very minimal workload, no weird tasks(video, proposal, outside activity). Only 2 mc quiz, less than 1000 word short questions weekly, 2k essay. No reading needed except for essay. Recommend.

I got A- with a B- essay, so... yea, good grade.

Those who said the quiz is hard.... it is hard. Though i got pretty high in the first one, and fucked up the last one. The questions are kinda random. If you are good at science(not phy chem bio, but general science) however, shouldn't be too bad.

the weekly assignment is basically copy and paste code from notes to hw, idk why they say it hard.

The project is a hassle indeed, but you don't actually need to use the data set from GEE but instead use external source. You can really just cheese it. They score the project very largely in presentation, especially the finally few questions that they ask you about after presenting. If you answer those well you easily hit high grades
reviews.translated_content: Very minimal workload, no weird tasks (video, proposal, outside activity). Only two multiple-choice quizzes, weekly short-answer questions under 1,000 words, and a 2,000-word essay. No reading needed except for the essay. Recommended. I got an A- with a B- essay, so... yeah, good grade. Those who said the quiz is hard.... it is hard. Though I got pretty high in the first one, and messed up the last one. The questions are kinda random. If you are good at science (not physics, chemistry, or biology, but general science), however, it shouldn't be too bad. The weekly assignment is basically copying and pasting code from notes to homework; I don’t know why they say it’s hard. The project is indeed a hassle, but you don’t actually need to use the dataset from GEE; you can use external sources instead. You can really just cheese it. They weight the project score heavily on the presentation, especially the final few questions they ask you after presenting. If you answer those well, you can easily hit high grades.

reviews.content: 这课真的难评，wl大➕给分差➕考的偏➕一堆作弊的，虽然没出grade但只能说老实人很难不烂🐢
reviews.translated_content: This course is really hard to evaluate. Heavy workload + poor grading + obscure exam questions + lots of cheating. Although grades haven’t been released yet, I can only say that honest students are likely to get poor grades.

reviews.content: You will learn a lot of technical skills.
reviews.translated_content: You will learn a lot of technical skills.

reviews.content: 对没有学过地理信息系统的人不太友好，一学期两个当堂quiz，15分钟25道题我写个der啊（orz），考得特别特别细，但七十多就有A，我应该拿了一个A一个A-。tutorial教google earth engine，有编程基础也不一定派得上用场，要filter data生成指定地图层，印度tutor口音太重完全听不懂导致tutorial教的东西只能自己摸索，一学期四个还是五个这种作业还要根据你生成的东西做文字分析，做的很认真，拿了一个B+剩下都是A-。期末有一个gp，其实就是自己做一个网站通过图文结合展示你们选择的主题，要有自己run出来的图像，pre的时候教授会问问题，我们组选了亚马逊雨林。最后总成绩居然有A-我还挺惊讶的，毕竟我纯小白。
reviews.translated_content: It’s not very friendly to those who haven’t studied geographic information systems. There were two in-class quizzes during the semester: 25 questions in 15 minutes—how was I supposed to write anything? (orz) The testing was extremely detailed, but scoring over 70 gets you an A. I probably got one A and one A-. The tutorials teach Google Earth Engine; having a programming background doesn’t necessarily help, as you need to filter data to generate specified map layers. The Indian tutor’s accent was so strong that I couldn’t understand at all, so I had to figure out the tutorial content on my own. There were four or five such assignments during the semester, requiring textual analysis based on your generated outputs. I worked very hard on them, getting one B+ and the rest A-. For the final, there was a group project, which essentially involved creating a website to present your chosen theme using images and text, including images you processed yourself. The professor asked questions during the presentation; our group chose the Amazon rainforest. I was quite surprised that my overall grade was an A-, given that I was a complete beginner.

reviews.content: 跑跑跑，wl巨大，去年被推荐来的，结果喜提b+。高考纯文，那个quiz我都记不下来，好多题都要精确到数字，复习了等于没复习。老师上课口音很重，tutor口音也很重，其他的不评价，完全是被去年的推荐坑来了，可能今年去年变化比较大吧。
reviews.translated_content: Run, run, run. The workload is huge. I came here based on last year's recommendations and ended up with a B+. Having a pure arts background from the Gaokao, I couldn't even memorize the quiz material; many questions required precise numerical answers. Revising felt pointless. The lecturer has a heavy accent, and the tutor does too. I won't comment on other aspects. I was completely misled by last year's recommendations; perhaps the course changed significantly between last year and this year.

reviews.content: 看了下ric评价，给分差wl大考试难应该是这个tutor的问题，然后prof讲课也特别无聊，ppt reader，要不然讲的是常识要不然太专业搞不懂原理。真的太痛苦了，好像worksheet里有一个错误就拿不到a range，我个人三次b+一次a-。individual essay对非专业学生来说特别不友好……除非换了tutor这门课才可以选一选。
reviews.translated_content: After checking reviews on RIC, the poor grading, heavy workload, and difficult exams seem to be this tutor’s issue. Also, the professor’s lectures are particularly boring; he just reads off the slides. Either he talks about common sense or gets too technical so you can’t understand the principles. It was really painful. It seems that making even one mistake in the worksheets means you won’t get an A-range grade. I got three B+s and one A-. The individual essay is particularly unfriendly to non-major students... Unless the tutor is changed, this course should only be chosen with caution.

reviews.content:
第一年新cc：attendance、in class quiz、midterm and final project各佔25%。固然最後拿了A，但亦無阻成為讀過最差的的cc沒有之一：lecturer和tutor的ppt雜亂無章、課上不停放youtube視頻、tutorial只是lecture wrap up、整個課程毫無知識點可言。教授也是崇尚科學至上，對於學生其他方面的討論卻置之不理。如果這是好grade cc那我可能還會推薦，但下面prof完sem給出來的distribution卻讓人卻步：A+: 96.11-98.84

A: 93-95.76

A-: 91.25-92.90

B+: 90.09-90.85

B: 85.09-89.82

B-:80.29-84.82

C+: 66.88-79.63

Class average is 88.32. 總結來說grade也好課程也好毫無可取之處，大家好好避雷就好。
reviews.translated_content: First year of this new Common Core course: attendance, in-class quiz, midterm, and final project each account for 25%. Although I eventually got an A, it did not stop this from being the worst CC I have ever taken, bar none: the lecturer’s and tutor’s PPTs were disorganised, they kept playing YouTube videos in class, tutorials were just lecture wrap-ups, and the entire course had no substantial knowledge points. The professor also worships scientism and ignores student discussions on other aspects. If this were a CC with favourable grading, I might still recommend it, but the grade distribution given by the professor after the semester makes one hesitate: A+: 96.11-98.84, A: 93-95.76, A-: 91.25-92.90, B+: 90.09-90.85, B: 85.09-89.82, B-: 80.29-84.82, C+: 66.88-79.63. Class average is 88.32. In summary, neither the grading nor the course has any merit; everyone should just avoid it.

reviews.content: 属于好龟课，但我说实话没有学到很多东西（流汗）
reviews.translated_content: It’s a GPA-friendly course, but to be honest, I didn’t learn much (sigh).

reviews.content: 非常好龟的课，期中单人pre，期末3人一组pre和一个essay。然后每节课有quiz，lecture不用签到，tutorial要。一个小tips是教授上课前会提前在Moodle上告诉你什么时候做quiz，所以就算不去上课只需要提前定好闹钟去做就OK了，quiz都是选择题AI直接秒了。这门课建议找认识的人提前组好队会好很多。最后是A-，不过同组小姐姐都是A和A＋所以还是值得大家无脑冲的课。
reviews.translated_content: A course with very generous grading. There was an individual presentation at mid-term, and a group presentation (in teams of three) plus an essay at the end. There was a quiz every class. Lecture attendance wasn’t taken, but tutorial attendance was. A small tip: the professor posts the quiz times on Moodle in advance, so even if you don’t attend class, you can just set an alarm and take the quiz. The quizzes are all multiple-choice, which AI can solve instantly. I recommend forming your team early with people you know; it helps a lot. I got an A-, but the girls in my group got As and A+s, so it’s definitely a course worth taking without hesitation.

reviews.content: 这节课属于如果你感兴趣，你能学到很多；如果你不感兴趣我，你可以什么都不学。Grade不容易烂，我属于和老师有共鸣但是不听课，比较轻松的拿了A+。个人认为这个课算是我理想中的大学课，老师不会通过各种方式逼你学，每个人应该对自己负责，也应该选择自己喜欢的大学方式。
reviews.translated_content: This course is such that if you are interested, you can learn a lot; if you are not interested, you can learn nothing. It is not easy to get a bad grade. I resonated with the instructor but didn’t attend lectures, and still got an A+ quite easily. Personally, I consider this course my ideal university class. The instructor doesn’t force you to learn through various means; everyone should be responsible for themselves and choose their own preferred way of studying at university.

reviews.content: 并不觉得很好龟，reflective essay主包认真准备了但分数没想象的高，有可能是主包不擅长写作的原因。总之虽然是ccst但感觉对文学能力的要求远高于理科思维之类的
reviews.translated_content: I don’t think it’s easy to get a good grade. I prepared seriously for the reflective essay, but the score wasn’t as high as I imagined; it might be because I’m not good at writing. In short, although it’s a CCST course, it seems to demand literary skills far more than scientific thinking or similar abilities.

reviews.content: wl还算小吧我觉得，平时lecture基本不需要听，给分的话只要上心做了应该还好，不知🐢如何
reviews.translated_content: I think the workload is relatively small. You basically don’t need to listen to the regular lectures. As for grading, it should be fine as long as you put in the effort, though I am not sure about the grades.

reviews.content: 老师非常和蔼，上课内容比较简单，易理解，不听课光看ppt也可以掌握，一个个人pre三分钟，一个小组pre一共12分钟，还有一片600-1000的essay还有几个quiz，总体容易理解，只要用心分就不会低。给的分都挺高的，但是最后评分是看百分比，出93点几，最后A+。好🐢！
reviews.translated_content: The instructor is very amiable. The lecture content is relatively simple and easy to understand; you can master it just by reading the PPTs without attending class. There is one individual presentation of three minutes, one group presentation totaling 12 minutes, a 600–1000 word essay, and a few quizzes. Overall, it is easy to understand, and as long as you put in the effort, your score won’t be low. The grading is quite generous. Since the final grade is based on percentages, I scored 93-point-something and ended up with an A+. Generous grading!

reviews.content: 超好🐢！课非常水，但是会莫名其妙有attendance。每周都有简单的quiz（可以现场翻笔记但是要快）。presentation和essay都还好，找了一下港大writing center最后写的挺好的。
reviews.translated_content: Generous grading! The course is very lightweight, but there are unexpected attendance checks. There are simple weekly quizzes (you can refer to your notes during the quiz, but you need to be quick). The presentation and essay are manageable; I consulted the HKU Writing Centre and ended up writing quite well.

reviews.content: 课程水水的，大部分课有限时quiz。老师要求线下完成，但是经常出现“有一百个人交了但是线下就70个人”（prof原话）的情况，所以他会随机在moodle上发几个survey，提交就有bonus这样。quiz开卷，难度不大，但最好还是做对。mid是一个pre，后面一个gp一个essay。分给的都挺好的。wl不算很大。最后A+
reviews.translated_content: The course is lightweight. Most classes have timed quizzes. The teacher requires offline completion, but situations often arise where “100 people submitted online but only 70 were present offline” (the professor’s own words), so he randomly posts a few surveys on Moodle, and submitting them earns bonus marks. The quizzes are open-book and not difficult, but it’s best to get them right. The midterm is a presentation, followed by a group project and an essay. The grading is quite generous. The workload isn’t heavy. I ended up with an A+.

reviews.content:
从龟的角度讲是好龟课，有几次简单开卷quiz（甚至有提示，教授说希望我们能从quiz里学到东西），一个个人pre（平均分大概20/25，不难为人），一个gp，但gp评标中大部分是给个人的分数，即使遇到free rider大概一不会被拖累太多。两个pre都是三分钟，教授对于他期待什么样的pre做了详细阐述和指导。lecture和tutorial都有签到。
学习内容上有很多生活中的例子，例如疫情、是否批准一种治疗PTSD药物、中药等。最后一节课讲了科学思维在选择专业和职业中的应用。是改变人思维方式的一门课。个人觉得蛮实用的，如果有些兴趣比较推荐
reviews.translated_content: From a grading perspective, it's a GPA-friendly course. There are a few simple open-book quizzes (there are even hints; the professor said he hopes we can learn something from the quizzes), one individual presentation (average score around 20/25, not difficult), and one group project. However, most of the group project marks are awarded individually, so even if you encounter a free rider, you probably won't be dragged down too much. Both presentations are three minutes long, and the professor gave detailed explanations and guidance on what he expects from a presentation. Attendance is taken for both lectures and tutorials. The learning content includes many examples from daily life, such as the pandemic, whether to approve a drug for treating PTSD, traditional Chinese medicine, etc. The last class discussed the application of scientific thinking in choosing majors and careers. It's a course that changes your way of thinking. Personally, I find it quite practical, and if you have some interest, I recommend it.

reviews.content:
This course is interesting but the grading is so harsh. I did everything right. I followed the feedback for my reflective essay and polished it until it was perfect. Our final group project was also very good and our presentation was excellent. My groupmates and I invested so much time in our group project. I attended all of the lectures and tutorials as well. Somehow I still got a B+. I have no idea what happened. Unless you're ok with B range, RUN!!

I am also so disappointed with this class's AI policy. Almost all the short films produced in our class were AI slop. Very few used AI as a tool and not a replacement and only three (if I recall correctly) did not use any AI at all. So disappointing. For a class about cinema, you'd think they valued human-made art more. I was so disheartened to realize that my group would probably receive the same grade as a group that fed a prompt into AI and barely put effort into their video.
